Do you have a few minutes, folks? Before I start talking about donations or deadlines, I want to tell you a quick story. I grew up on a cattle ranch, and when I came home from school, I’d disappear into the outdoors for hours at a time. I rarely went back to the house empty-handed — bringing home reptiles and other creatures (much to my mom’s chagrin!). My childhood mischief aside, I can trace many of my core values back to that cattle ranch. **It’s where I discovered my love of the great outdoors** — and how important it is to take care of our lands and the wildlife that roam them. **It’s where I learned the dignity of hard work from my parents** — and the belief that every person in our country willing to work hard deserves a real chance at success. **It’s also where I learned how to connect and negotiate with others** — cows can be pretty good listeners when they want to be! I’ve brought these values and life lessons to the Senate, where I’m fighting every day to protect our public lands for future generations, lower costs for working families, and build a more prosperous future for all. I’m ready to keep up this critical work alongside our Democratic Senate Majority, but our campaign is counting on your support to counter Republican attacks and win next year. **[Will you help us build our voter outreach operations and support candidates in New Mexico and all across the country? Before I start talking about donations or deadlines, I want to tell you a quick story. I grew up on a cattle ranch, and when I came home from school, I’d disappear into the outdoors for hours at a time. I rarely went back to the house empty-handed — bringing home reptiles and other creatures (much to my mom’s chagrin!). My childhood mischief aside, I can trace many of my core values back to that cattle ranch. It’s where I discovered my love of the great outdoors — and how important it is to take care of our lands and the wildlife that roam them. It’s where I learned the dignity of hard work from my parents — and the belief that every person in our country willing to work hard deserves a real chance at success. It’s also where I learned how to connect and negotiate with others — cows can be pretty good listeners when they want to be! I’ve brought these values and life lessons to the Senate, where I’m fighting every day to protect our public lands for future generations, lower costs for working families, and build a more prosperous future for all. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

show your thanks!
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56020?t=6&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE) We can’t believe how much Biden has done for our country, so we’re sending him a HUGE card to thank him for his hard work!

[**So you’ve been personally selected to sign our letter thanking President Biden for fighting for the American people! Please, we need 10,000 signatures by midnight to demonstrate massive support! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56020?t=7&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE) | [Donate $3 to sign the letter now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56020?t=8&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE)
---
TO: President Biden
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: I’m so grateful.

**Dear President Biden,

I’m so thankful for everything you’ve done as President!

**Despite MAGA turmoil, over the last two and a half years, you’ve fought TIRELESSLY for the American people — defending abortion rights, confirming an incredible Supreme Court Justice, saving Social Security from GOP cuts, and creating millions of jobs for the people.**

I know standing up to MAGA Republican attacks isn’t easy, but it is always the right thing to do.

So as the 2024 race kicks into high gear, I wanted to show my support and thank you for being such an amazing leader for our country!

[**I hope you know that there are MILLIONS of us across the nation who stand with you. That’s why I’m signing this letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to thank you and to keep electing incredible Democrats up and down the ballot »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56020?t=9&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE)** | [SPACE RUNNING OUT: Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56020?t=10&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE)
---
**_X A THANKFUL AMERICAN_**
| | Paid for by VPP
(www.protectvoting.org)
Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE).**

[Click here](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/fewer-emails/?t=3&akid=11521%2E878179%2ETs-oeE) to request fewer emails. Fellow American,

We’ve known one another for a long time, so you know by now that when I ask for favors there is a reason.

I’ll be straight with you: my campaign needs your immediate financial support. A lot of folks around the country don’t think that my seat is at risk, but the truth is that no one knows that for sure.

You know that Democrats HATE ME.

I know that Democrats HATE ME.

But I bet you didn’t know that they hate me to the tune of $52,000 per day, did you?

When my opponent announced his fundraising numbers for the third quarter earlier this month, it shocked me. From July 1st to September 30th, he raised more than $4.7 million from the liberal coasts that he’s going to use to smear my good name ahead of next year’s election.

**Texans know me; Americans know me.** It’s no secret what I stand for. But I’ll tell you this: if Democrats are allowed to vastly outspend us on the airwaves, there is no telling what kind of twisted lies they’ll try to spin to make my supporters flip sides.

**We cannot – WE WILL not allow them to win. I need to know you’re still with me and Senate Republicans.[ If you are, I’m asking for you to send us just $5 right now.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=38a59ff8083a407d9d07ee600a8f10ee&_e=Hxte4PsOm1x2-ZQSxPWjEWIlGGuzt8PSxb41jgMevFREN7UClpBFQmtOYD2XHdbAGgQfuNmg63kCOyJEkDbfUocveMbK6CAiA2A9bchKKHVuw3pcFUbm-cQ11IXzIc1AnHP5owv_tz35RRN_P1vhB1f6Jbv-QEypcjZ_sILCbD7f-FiWW3YcLuGaR_HEDi71p8AVscjpAbgEu4v96yB8A3CT_xdBeCtWsIbqjtTG2Otro1S-FI_CXoCitzLkRGY7Gole81mvtLqLxcWrWnvPFlyZahFHXJaMZNN5HaNf3DP5zzKQlgQ4ovMJLPzUEQ5csut3PlyuzC_xihufGoLxOBvqjKzsxfHzmmAzTeEv35j6M-PT_L0gOLAMK6Y-sW166IzRZy-1Sq8NqPODfwcp9yvIGRpeMBZFr-1XJFBQjlMt8Pb7VgFLxfnBMHA3MD-a)**

[**Chip in $5 IMMEDIATELY >>**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=38a59ff8083a407d9d07ee600a8f10ee&_e=Hxte4PsOm1x2-ZQSxPWjEWIlGGuzt8PSxb41jgMevFREN7UClpBFQmtOYD2XHdbAGgQfuNmg63kCOyJEkDbfUocveMbK6CAiA2A9bchKKHVuw3pcFUbm-cQ11IXzIc1AnHP5owv_tz35RRN_P1vhB1f6Jbv-QEypcjZ_sILCbD7f-FiWW3YcLuGaR_HEDi71p8AVscjpAbgEu4v96yB8A3CT_xdBeCtWsIbqjtTG2Otro1S-FI_CXoCitzLkRGY7Gole81mvtLqLxcWrWnvPFhOFKspnivfcvhMZCtBuiieIvI35gytTMWjTKUQ-lX2D3giKfWIflAWz3P7xU5h-Z6SNG6iQeIhbwWr31k6uvi_rqXEcVvfrHPHf-rx-9xO4olE2tPi9Ln2TZvz1gOctpuDT66v9MGcRs-mLNJk04y8dSk2vkqS-O6yHipCRXj5R)

| So while our end-of-month deadline is just 2 days from now, I’m writing to you about the countdown with under 100 days until early voting begins in the U.S. Senate primary.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4341%2E5257348%2ENEQvUH)
Hey Derek — I know you’ve been getting a lot of emails from me ahead of our big end-of-month deadline. But today, instead of focusing on a short-term deadline in 2 days, I want to ask you to make a small monthly donation to sustain this campaign for the next 100 days. Let me explain why.
Because I don’t accept corporate PAC money, and because we are running against over thirty candidates in the all-parties jungle primary for this U.S. Senate race, it is no exaggeration to say that my ability to win this race depends on whether you donate to emails like this one.
I’ve been the subject of attacks from Donald Trump and his cronies in Congress for months on end.
The Intel Committee. The censure. The name-calling. The lies on _Fox News_. The attacks on stage at massive campaign rallies and GOP conventions.
Our ability to respond to every last attack depends on whether grassroots Democrats like you stand with me and our campaign’s message to defend our democracy. To fight for every Californian. To build a planet worthy of leaving to our children and grandchildren.
**So while our end-of-month deadline is just 2 days from now, I’m writing to you about the countdown with under 100 days until early voting begins in the U.S. Senate primary.**
Trump throws attacks at me like the burger he threw at a White House wall when Attorney General Bill Barr told him there was no election fraud in 2020 _(seriously, Google it)._
So we’ll need the resources not only to respond but to build the biggest grassroots campaign that California has ever seen. So we can take this righteous fight for our democracy to the United States Senate.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to begin making a monthly recurring contribution to my campaign today. I need you with me for the long haul. Are you in? name: Speaker Mike Johnson
subject: My core principals
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35794%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WxhZJN%2fnVc1Rsg0aY3OYCQ&sysid=1)
---
Fellow American,

To my core, I believe the most important things in life are **faith, family, and freedom** - _but those foundations of our great country are under attack._

Right now, in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**_This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness._**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Will you please stand with me immediately?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35705%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NaasQdBgwzn7AaxAmbtDUg&sysid=1)

[** CHIP IN > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35706%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ivI2oIqdqd5AaGDp28Oslg&sysid=1)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. # Dina Titus's Support of Bidenomics Hurts Nevadans
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vshHFL6iFN

Please, please, please chip in just $1 or more to help me qualify
for the next Republican debate

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oshHFL6iFN

Friend, I'm serious when I say I need your help more than ever
before. This is truly a make-or-break moment.

I'm still short of the 70,000 donor requirement for the next
presidential debate! I met the polling requirement, but I need a
few more donors like you in order to share my optimistic,
conservative message with America.

I'm respectfully asking for your help today. Will you PLEASE
chip in just $1 to help?

CHIP IN $1 TO HELP ME WIN!

I think you'll agree that America's future is on the line in
this election. I believe the Republican Party - the Great
Opportunity Party - is at its best when we have an optimistic
voice on stage that Americans can believe in.

It's time to restore faith in America. It's time to get back to
the conservative values that make us exceptional and move on from
the failures of the Biden years. We can't afford to push people
away with the wrong messenger at our helm. We can't afford to
lose!

Your donation of $1 or more will help me be a voice for the
voiceless and stand up for those who are being hurt by Joe Biden
and the radical Left's agenda.

My message is simple but crystal clear.

If you're able-bodied, you work.

If you take out a loan, you pay it back.

If you commit a violent crime, you go to jail.

If you're a man, you should play sports against other men.

America needs more victors and fewer victims.

It's time to choose greatness over grievance and victory over
victimhood. But I'm running out of time!

CHIP IN $1 TO HELP ME WIN!

Will you help me get over this hump and secure my spot on the
debate stage? I can't wait to take Joe Biden to task and tell
America about my plan to restore our country. I'm ready to SHOUT
our message from the rooftops!

We've already come so far in the past 5 months of this
campaign. We've had tens of thousands of donors join us, and tens
of thousands more have interacted with our campaign to share
their hopes and dreams for what an American future led by someone
not named Joe Biden might look like!

I want to make it clear to everyone that I will NEVER BACK DOWN
from this fight and let the radical Left win.

I'm fighting for every kid in inner-city Chicago, rural
Iowa, or suburban South Carolina who has big dreams and just
needs the encouragement and opportunity to achieve them.

I'm fighting for the parents and grandparents who are
worried sick that their children and grandchildren might not
inherit the America they know and love.

I'M FIGHTING FOR YOU because I love this country and I want
you to live in the freest, fairest land on God's green earth!

I'm praying for your help today, Friend. Will you help me climb
this mountain and tell ALL of America the truth the Left doesn't
want them to hear? Will you help me preach the good news that we
can do amazing, unbelievable things as a country if we get big
government out of the way, get back to our values, and have a
little faith?

Please, please, please chip in just $1 or more to help me
qualify for the next Republican debate and share this message
with America.

CHIP IN $1 TO HELP ME WIN!

God Bless You!

Tim Scott

name: Shift WA
subject: SURVEY: Halloween Scaries
body:
Given it's Halloween, we took the liberty of imagining a few "scary" costumes that best represent some of the Democrats' scariest policies. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62409489:sEMNr6iNR:m:1:2610672541:207A919376BA26C53CC23D8FE4584856:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends, During the last few years, increasing Democrat control of Olympia has resulted in many scary policies for people across Washington. Just a few examples: * Democrats' energy tax hikes - including their carbon tax - have left working families struggling to cover basic living expenses, from the cost they pay at the pump to the cost of heating their homes to the cost of groceries. * Democrats' long-term care tax promises to take even more money out of workers' paychecks, with nothing "long-term" or "caring" for many. * Democrats realized their state income tax obsession with their passage of a capital gains income tax, which is now under review by the U.S. Supreme Court. * Democrats' soft-on-crime policies - like their ban on police pursuits - have effectively blocked law enforcement officers from doing their jobs, impacting rising crime rates. Given it's Halloween, we took the liberty of imagining a few "scary" costumes that best represent some of the Democrats' scariest policies. AND, we want to know, based on the Democrat policies, which of our Halloween costume ideas do you find the scariest? **_[Take our survey now!](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62409490:sEMNr6iNR:m:1:2610672541:207A919376BA26C53CC23D8FE4584856:r)_** ** ** **Gas Tax Vampire:** * Wear a vampire costume with fangs, a cape, and pale makeup. * Accessorize by attaching small gasoline pump icons or price tags to your cape. * Carry a fake gas can with "Gas Tax" written on it. ** ** **Bureaucratic "Long-Term Care Tax" Zombie:** * Wear a typical zombie costume with torn clothing and zombie makeup. * Attach "Long-Term Care Tax" labels to your clothing. * Carry a prop that symbolizes inefficiency, like a tangled web of red tape or a broken calculator. **State Income Tax Monster:** * Dress up as a colorful and playful monster with a big mouth. * Attach fake paper money (or play money) to your costume, with bills sticking out of the monster's mouth. * Accessorize with a sign that says, "State Income Tax Monster." **" Soft-on-Crime" Fighter:** * Dress in a mismatched, eccentric outfit with various elements from different superhero costumes. * Carry an oversized, comically large "Criminal Justice Manual" that appears exaggerated and impractical. * Accessorize with a prop that symbolizes a humorous and unconventional crime-fighting tool, such as a giant rubber chicken. We hope you'll participate in our survey before Halloween - and share it with your friends and family to help draw attention to the Democrats' many scary policies. Look out for the survey results on Halloween Day! Happy Halloween, The Shift WA Team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62409491:sEMNr6iNR:m:1:2610672541:207A919376BA26C53CC23D8FE4584856:r)
---
|
This message was intended for: [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com) and sent from Shift Washington. If you would like to send this message to some of your friends, you can [click here](http://click.shiftwa.org/forwardthis/ft.php?mID=14328566&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&ch=49000b887de404a22f48ed48dd2d4356&schema=echo3) to do so.

You can also stay up to date on our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/shiftwa/) & [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShiftWA). If you believe you received this message in error or no longer wish to receive emails from Shift Washington, [click to unsubscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/p/osEMNr6iNR).

body:

I've got a number you're going to want to take a look at.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osBEUr6isN

Friend,

News of our record fundraising haul from the last quarter has hit
the press and we've got big things coming because of the support
we've brought in. The doubters had their heyday, and yet again,
we've proved them.

Now, we're bringing the fight right to the Hawkeye State, making
progress on visiting the good people of Iowa in all 99 counties,
and EARNING this nomination. But after two debates and another
incredible fundraising showing, we have truly showed our hand as
the threat in this race, and we are about to face attacks from
every angle to keep us from winning in Iowa. We cannot let this
take us down.

Help me keep it up: Chip in $15

Other candidates are taking the American people for granted and
feeling entitled to votes. That couldn't be further from my game
plan. I am on the ground, building relationships, and earning the
grassroots support that'll be necessary to win this election, and
this will only be made harder as other candidates attempt to take
us down in the coming months. I KNOW what it takes to win
elections, but this is my first nationwide race, and I am
counting on your support more than ever to cover this new ground.

We've just entered our critical sprint leading up to the Iowa
Caucus on January 15th, and coming together now will make the
difference when that night comes. If we step back and lose in
this first nominating contest, we drop the ball for the future
generations of this country and risk losing next November. Losing
to Joe Biden... and losing freedom that soldiers have shed blood
and tears for.

All
across Iowa so far, I've gained incredible support and
endorsements from political, evangelical, agricultural, and local
business leaders, but I'll need YOUR support to get me through
the rest of this stretch.

Chip in
$25

Chip in
$47

Chip in
$75

Chip in
$100

Chip in any amount you can

When we win Iowa, Friend, we won't slow down. We're going all the
way, and we have to raise the resources we'll need to make it.
The people of this state are getting to know me, and we're
scaring the rest of this field. They know they can't catch up in
this critical state, and it's only the beginning. Your donation
will help us keep meeting Iowans and keep dominating across the
state. We can fight back against the millions that will be waged
to hold us back if we raise our own. Grassroots supporters are
who will decide the fate of this election. That's you.

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

Contribution rules

This contribution is made from my own funds, and funds are not

and not with a corporate or business credit card or a card issued
to another person.

I am at least eighteen years old. I am not, nor am I making this
contribution on behalf of, a corporation, labor organization,
national bank, foreign national without a green card, a federal
contractor, or any other federally impermissible source.

Ron
DeSantis was a member of the United States Navy. Use of his

## U.S. to Land Unmanned Spacecraft on Moon
The U.S. is headed [back to the moon within a few weeks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQQNGvMR1osI2BwsWTnug2bUoEw7BMZDwIe0H5-2hTpz7Fle7nY3xMHDg-P6adfF5lnDDzRWMNpYFSm9EWi1-JNJmCfO36zrVgurrYvNOrdTPNzjgzQ9cvzWwXxGWmdu113xTsNWhTgwHomwZsZREtQutIz9S106os0MJZzupLOOaN1vAtF50Vyl4Ev-V8JGX-KT0oPdz3XR1yJOQ3Kz0kZIpISg9RrqnEcheJZZJX3spDwhuUGV55H5O8TiRl_kdGinSn4vTLcXMInFyrLDz3icNvNf894ScAAP__sGVfQw), testing a new privately-built lunar lander ahead of NASA's planned 2025 manned moon mission. It will be the first moon landing for Americans since Apollo 17 in 1972, and the world's first commercial moon landing. The private NOVA-C lander was built by Intuitive Machines in Houston and will launch from Florida in mid-November. It'll carry NASA instruments and commercial cargo under contract with NASA to a "soft landing" on the lunar South Pole. [Here's a photo](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uhDAQBp_G7ozWP2CucJHmukubEhmzho2MjcAHyttHpE79fdLMfL2Gl6dEef70K7oay-BDpRMHCUKDUHowfHIRUaHm6GT36DsLupd8cRIxPkYfZN-pEWTbt6O1RtoOVTTRAienQGkJGuDRtmAaE4IJcB9G7K2PzABOVMvefBfKdcGYfsqJexPKypNbat0Opj-YejL1vK6rOTYf8F6ZelKub7pdxerDQhkPkcvpRRC0CikS-pPyLJbyPmrJfHfTdlFKdHSWGZhXT-mPU__P_g0AAP__Rx9aSA). The mission is one of several to transport cargo and collect data ahead of the manned mission. The goal is to carry heavier cargo loads each time, paving the way to [build permanent infrastructure](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd0TLQmwoKF7jLq-90lrDOibCYNkkp_z9KVdfPc3MfN2mG6Wcyv0_bezbUicKLb14UiA1SNST6aJfmJF1x171zvYDaKu61YND52YHESwS0jKbhdBZFx1FbZXrkkdArUADuOsVzMWEYAIMPePMdqBFGOCYWj0uj5pKW3nJ7_ri4xLq1mW_trafQv8TOAocaQ5Kf4jAsdQXySDzs9AhM5XIh1zr82y1yMZhLTXX-1uGuu1U3rLQSXI_6oNDO2Uq7Zk-kXKjsKbCp8BRadvDAChw7A4f9--Uczr7QRi4b5Tyr1L7-9BPAAAA__-uWGiE) on the moon.
## Gallup: Americans Satisfied With Their Lives
The vast majority of Americans [are satisfied with their personal lives](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb0TngxgyMHTxlq4drTM-x1dhiAyK1b-v0rnzG97T-7pPd5Ik-fFJO4e2lolikxdPPWgDGs1kuyWszMim49APNz84ML7vtmCvN0f9PHtvBox-MMaS75mdR6A5cicBAU0PBuB2vYK92BhtBDcwzuwdrcoCL9LKcfkuktvGa_opLz4usexdCltrz6rMh8JR4ZglcuazvqHCcWNKbdOUF31ySplrVTjSzodEylVXalJX4UU_-aglU9JJXlz1u0nh2B1heZ6SktTBKQuPnST9idv_H34DAAD__2Z_X6c), despite the world's troubles, according to a new Gallup Poll that shows 83% saying they are "somewhat" or "very" satisfied. Gallup measured life satisfaction across nine categories, including family life, work life, housing, community, health, and income. Family life scored the highest, with 90% saying they were "very/somewhat satisfied." [Here's the detailed breakdown.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwU4HAUELijR2lzalsweLbmYVR8hd7u0zSZ36L_6Z7-O23ICYjvUddvQ15QVCpQcuvWy1bJVeTBN9QlSoG_S9nUbrpB77ZvMxahzcNN2d0b1OCJMNMlow02DuvY0NeSWV7qWWchoGaToTggnSWVR3HB0kYSRGqvnqPjMddcPEr_zAqwt5b9hvtZ5F6DehZqHmA5-lW4H56_ztQs1nZhZqNk6O4yjUDDteFOAoLcO1Ir_aApVKIoztiVfJB3DLlLCDcn43l4_nk5ipWCeMXHcg_jvX_yF-AgAA__-qk2AO) The 2023 personal satisfaction levels align with the range Gallup has seen for the past 45 years. The lowest satisfaction scores were in 1979, and the record high was in January 2020, just two months before the Covid pandemic struck.
## "Friends" Star Matthew Perry Found Dead
"Friends" star [Matthew Perry drowned this weekend](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvMR1oGBtYChevodvXpkTeYbw4MjYyo3X276OkTn2Lq_NxX-8uxJCe_93BVnxeHUl48dpDq6FFvZpms54ZWTds-3G-jRPoW9_slkw_EwMTkxs8Tg_Cx2jYkJkJ3TA2wSKg7kEDzMMApjNEhmAaGR98m5xXBngLkkv3mUOSnX185xeXjvLRRLuLnJfS_xQuCpdaa-fzV-J6_XSFCyfhIi6kg5MoXHwJnLarvcSV9nAiO9f25FLe7cZua4rdzhpiDNc4KQPPw4X4u5K_5d8BAAD__0udXOE) while in his hot tub at home. Police said no drugs were found on the scene, and no foul play is suspected. Perry struggled with drug addiction problems throughout his life. In his recent memoir, he said [he spent $7 million on rehab programs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLvK3DAQRp9G7mRGF98KFWncbdqUZlYarRVkycjDmn37sKn_7oMPDofz57E9MOVUXr_xIMexbug5vWlTIA1IbTbbBReJNJmOnBqXeZzAzKrb3WInNYBaooLR4xQAtcfRLjbSQE9juuQ0aKPAACzDALa33lsP00j6SfOEUVigkLi2_m9NhXeK-VPf1Hpfjy67nfm8hPkl9Cr0et9378vTf0-h1y9a6FXBd89Crwcy73TLk1r7yNgSlXBJ9FybDIkuWaPE88RGhWVo9S6pvCSyHGy_85G75sJ5p5zTNU7CwuvAlP-b8M9h_gUAAP__5bVj2w), almost dying at one point from opioids. He was in several hit movies and TV shows, but his 10-year run on "Friends," where he played the anxious, sarcastic Chandler Bing, was his claim to fame. [Here's a roundup of some of Chandler Bing's funniest lines](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDtu6zAQAE8jdRSWH-tTsHiNO782pUAul9ImlGhQjAX79IFTpxxggAHm4zbfHCfel_9uI1tjnh1WftAsQWgQSs-mDTYSKdItWdlPYz-AHmW7WnBeyhgiQEQnTfAeJ6nxgmEcJz_Jlq0CpSVogOlyAdMZRIMw9KQ8jYOLjQEKXHPpPjPvdaWYnvlBpcO8tcmutd6PRv9r1LVR1_M8O__9ekWi8BYadUV30LM4_FrdG-tKwtNRBa5uD4mK8LwvIu8kEu9UDpGjcCmJyhu1xYb7ySnx0Q-NgWVznH7D9e8PPwEAAP__V8hhSg).

# Rural Broadband

**Peter -** Have you used the internet today? Or high-speed WiFi? Probably so.

Think about all of the things in your life that require access to the internet, then consider all of those that simply do not have access to it.

In rural areas across the country, people don’t have access to the internet or speeds that support at-home jobs, schooling, and other necessities.

It’s true: we now live in the digital age, and the internet is no longer a luxury, it is required of us.

As the job market changes, especially after the pandemic, we know that being without access to high-quality internet cannot be considered an “option.” Even things like job hunting and shopping for basic household items have moved to a mainly online process.

Investing in rural broadband and improving access for rural Americans is a must.

With a new focus on giving these communities the access they need, we see that not only are jobs created, but that rural areas can finally catch up to the processes that make our lives easier and less time-consuming.

Peter - As someone who lives in a rural area, I can attest to the need for expanded access to this necessity, and I am ready to be a voice in Congress that will ensure that we improve and expand on this issue. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/Logo_white_rectangle.jpg]
On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We'll use this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st congressional district.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In the news
https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401 [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
The national media is paying more and more attention to our race every day. Last week, POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401] reported that Democrats "are entertaining a once-unlikely prospect: retaking the House majority by winning in the South."
The story specifically highlighted the SC-01 racial gerrymandering case that will soon come before the Supreme Court [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/17/2181780/-My-swing-district-has-its-date-before-the-Supreme-Court] .
Per POLITICO: "It's impossible to know how many seats could become competitive, but the party is hoping a handful may come into play and that new maps could even threaten the likes of ... Nancy Mace."
https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/ [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/] ran a story explaining how new congressional maps "could be drawn in time to change the electoral landscape in 2024, when Democrats need a net gain of just five seats to take control of the House."
According to Roll Call, the SC-01 Supreme Court case "may also impact the federal redistricting litigation in Florida, which involves similar racial gerrymandering claims."
https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/ [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
And back home in the Lowcountry, the Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/] published an editorial calling on the Supreme Court to redraw the lines of SC-01 — so that the map "reflects the true electoral nature of our lower coast, not a district that the GOP bleached by moving thousands of Black voters to other districts."
On the picket line
https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers]
Union of Southern Service Workers [https://ussw.org/]
Michael expressed solidarity with the workers of the Waffle House on Garners Ferry Road in Columbia, South Carolina, who began a three-day strike [https://twitter.com/RaiseUptheSouth/status/1677737443145949184] on this month after delivering to management their petition to organize.
As a business executive with nearly four decades of private sector experience — including several years as a leader in South Carolina's food industry — Michael knows firsthand that employees throughout any organization deserve fair pay and safe working conditions.
https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/ [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Holy City Sinner [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Michael steadfastly stands behind the striking Waffle House staff as they seek sensible concessions from management and strive for a better quality of life for restaurant workers in South Carolina.
He also urged Nancy Mace — who often mentions her past experience as a Waffle House waitress [https://twitter.com/NancyMace/status/1451926458994151427?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1451926458994151427%7Ctwgr%5Eb80d1ca7caee292360b8edb17aecebf62c52def8%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dailykos.com%2Fstories%2F2023%2F7%2F25%2F2183281%2F-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers] on the campaign trail — to similarly endorse the demands of those on strike.
In the arena
https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486 [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486]
Rep. Nancy Mace [https://twitter.com/RepNancyMace/status/1684928879235072000?s=20]
Nancy Mace attended a POLITICO event [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486] last week, where she warned that Republicans need to refocus on "child care, maternal care, prenatal care [and] abortion" if they want to keep control of the House.
It was more cheap talk from Mace, who — time and again — has flip-flopped on the issues that matter most to women and working families.
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans?emci=9f4780c9-692d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans?emci=9f4780c9-692d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
The Guardian [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans]
Here are the facts:
*
In
2019,
Nancy
Mace
voted
for
a
six-week
abortion
ban
[https://www.scstatehouse.gov/votehistory.php?KEY=16575]
in
the
South
Carolina
legislature.
*
In
2021,
she
voted
against
the
expansion
of
the
child
tax
credit
[https://mace.house.gov/media/press-releases/mace-so-called-american-rescue-plan-was-never-about-covid-19-relief]
in
the
American
Rescue
Plan.
*
In
January,
she
co-sponsored
H.R.
7
[https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/5/2179435/-My-opponent-is-co-sponsoring-another-extreme-bill]
,
which
would
make
health
coverage
that
includes
reproductive
care
ineligible
for
federal
funding.
*
In
July,
she
voted
for
an
NDAA
amendment
that
makes
it
harder
for
servicewomen
to
access
health
care
[https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/17/2181768/-Nancy-Mace-called-it-an-asshole-move-Then-she-voted-for-it]
—
a
policy
she
herself
called
an
"asshole
move."
Nothing about Nancy Mace's record is pro-children or pro-women. She should stop pretending otherwise.
On social media
https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore [https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore]
Michael surpassed 6,600 Twitter followers [https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore] this week! Can you help us reach 7,500 followers before the end of the month?
And if you aren't already, make sure to keep up with our campaign on Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress] , Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/mbm_sc01/] , Threads [https://www.threads.net/@mbm_sc01] , LinkedIn [https://www.linkedin.com/company/moore4sc/about/] and TikTok. [https://www.tiktok.com/@michaelbmoore4sc]
From the trail
https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/ [https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/]
Michael had a fun weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, where he helped some talented artists promote a forthcoming graphic novel [https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/] about his great-great-grandfather: Civil War hero and Recontruction-era Congressman Robert Smalls.
https://screenrant.com/defiant-the-story-of-robert-smalls-sdcc-interview/ [https://screenrant.com/defiant-the-story-of-robert-smalls-sdcc-interview/]
At a time when Republican politicians like Ron DeSantis are seeking to rewrite our nation's history [https://www.msnbc.com/the-reidout/reidout-blog/ron-desantis-florida-slavery-curriculum-rcna96052] — exploiting partisan divides at the expense of our children's education — Michael believes it's more important than ever for leaders to embrace the totality of America's legacy.
https://blackgirlnerds.com/the-creative-team-behind-defiant-the-robert-smalls-story/ [https://blackgirlnerds.com/the-creative-team-behind-defiant-the-robert-smalls-story/]
Part of that important work is elevating the stories of lesser-known patriots like Robert Smalls, who — in the face of unfathomable hardship — never stopped working to make America a more perfect Union [https://www.nps.gov/people/robert-smalls.htm] .
Michael is proud to be seeking the same House seat that his great-great-grandfather held nearly 140 years ago.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to flip this swing district.
Together — indivisible — we'll build a brighter future for South Carolina.

Nancy Mace [] Nancy Mace attended a POLITICO event [] last week, where she warned that Republicans need to refocus on "child care, maternal care, prenatal care [and] abortion" if they want to keep control of the House. It was more cheap talk from Mace, who — time and again — has flip-flopped on the issues that matter most to women and working families. = [=] The Guardian [] Here are the facts: In 2019, Nancy Mace voted for a six-week abortion ban [] in the South Carolina legislature. In 2021, she voted against the expansion of the child tax credit [] in the American Rescue Plan. In January, she co-sponsored H.R. 7 [] , which would make health coverage that includes reproductive care ineligible for federal funding. In July, she voted for an NDAA amendment that makes it harder for servicewomen to access health care [] — a policy she herself called an "asshole move." Nothing about Nancy Mace's record is pro-children or pro-women. She should stop pretending otherwise. On social media [] Michael surpassed 6,600 Twitter followers [] this week! Can you help us reach 7,500 followers before the end of the month? And if you aren't already, make sure to keep up with our campaign on Facebook [] , Instagram [] , Threads [] , LinkedIn [] and TikTok. [] From the trail [] Michael had a fun weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, where he helped some talented artists promote a forthcoming graphic novel [] about his great-great-grandfather: Civil War hero and Recontruction-era Congressman Robert Smalls. [] At a time when Republican politicians like Ron DeSantis are seeking to rewrite our nation's history [] — exploiting partisan divides at the expense of our children's education — Michael believes it's more important than ever for leaders to embrace the totality of America's legacy. [] Part of that important work is elevating the stories of lesser-known patriots like Robert Smalls, who — in the face of unfathomable hardship — never stopped working to make America a more perfect Union [] . Michael is proud to be seeking the same House seat that his great-great-grandfather held nearly 140 years ago. On our team [] There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started. | More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zos6ao56u670apar53gnhisqmtaguj8och8sn488_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0i2cin2tdnq5r3bp0i2mh60oj6chg6co334lonbdumeuqn4thl6nh7acrj4lonbdulmkoj9dblmnijbd1km6piasblmvb38ddgegqbectls8qbfcejm79r3kti46h22sh2s8i66p70sdge8or6cdh2bs)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0u8ada4v49nehmuf5lhep77ek5nm54779oumvjg_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge8or6cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqg9169bhemrt2thlsg91b8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r49fg) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4dtvd9alolt45u0pqvum0tqnt4ldj99ep0evfs0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge8or6cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqg9169bhemrt2thlsg91b8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r49fg)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z71hget3u354tjml7c3m20pnq35vh04uu6u6c2p0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0i2cin2tdnq5r3bp0i2mh60oj6chg6co334lonbdumeuqn4thl6nh7acrj4lonbdulmkoj9dblmnijbd1km6piasblmvb38ddgegqbectls8qbfcejm8gq48bi4bh28or4s3hm1p33cphm49fg)

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, can
I share a picture with you?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]Adam Schiff at his Bar Mitzvah

This is me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah.

It’s easy to chuckle at this photo — and see just how far fashion has
changed since that classic absolutely righteous 1970s bowtie — but it is
also an opportunity to tell you about my upbringing.

My family moved around while I was in school before settling in Danville,
California. My parents and my teachers cultivated in me a love of and
respect for public service.

While in speech class, I remember listening to recordings of great
speakers like President John F. Kennedy, the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King,
Jr., and Winston Churchill. I admired the way they used language — how
they could inspire millions of people to take action through the power of
their words.

I wanted to use words — and actions — in the service of progressive
change. And I wanted to be part of the great struggle for the future.

After graduating high school (I was not valedictorian as some have claimed
— my B in Band held me back), I went on to college and law school. There,
I learned how to gather the facts and argue my case.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]Adam Schiff at his graduation

After law school, I was inspired by friends serving in office and decided
I was ready to try. I ran for the California Assembly.

And,
Derek, I
lost.

It was bruising to lose, but I didn’t give up. And then, I lost again. But
I refused to give up hope.

I continued campaigning and rallying — and just two years later, I was
elected to represent the 21st District in the State Senate. I was sworn in
as the California Senate’s youngest member at just 36 years old.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]Adam Schiff and Eve Schiff with a yard sign

After the term finished, I threw my hat in the ring to take on the
Republican incumbent in California’s 27th Congressional District. This was
seen as one of the seats that could decide the House majority. Money
poured into this election — the most expensive in history at the time. I
barnstormed the district — speaking with voters to share our message.

Those long months of hard work paid off: Despite the election of George W.
Bush as president and Republicans maintaining their House majority, we
flipped that seat and won that race, and I became only the second Democrat
to represent the district in history.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]Adam Schiff and family celebrating

I’ve taken a lot of tough fights in my time,
Derek — and it’s all been in
the name of giving back. We have a saying as part of my Jewish faith —
“Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world.

There’s a lot that’s been broken, and a lot to fix. I’m ready to do my
part to leave our state and country in a better place, and to repair our
broken democracy, but I can’t do it alone.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=oct2023_abs_em.TYf9-c&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]With less than 150 days until Californians go to the polls, my team
needs your help to share our message across California’s 58 counties and
win this U.S. Senate race. Will you pitch in $5 to help us in these final
few months?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1040?c0=oct2023_abs_em.VpyBRd&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_REA_GEN_NO_20231030_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1009&akid=4331%2E5257348%2E_VPNCx ]EXPRESS DONATE $5

Adam

name: Mike Johnson
subject: Let me introduce myself
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672523%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xXYPF7cJWQCqn7M0UyAOWA&sysid=1)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672524%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Jkpuzwu66Xm3eGdNR60bGg&sysid=1) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672535%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uOO4rA3jnGKSNKgYlHciew&sysid=1)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672536%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EVpRHeLCjJA3x5q76OMlrA&sysid=1)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672537%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EJ2KKm1yFcsRuSVGDobSxw&sysid=1)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672538%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4X3DIw2HDCSYyoh3CtrCnw&sysid=1)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672539%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c2sFAt09uWuT7p9V6OBZ3g&sysid=1)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672530%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ofBKFEMgHADQrIKv5iaCVw&sysid=1)

[** CHIP IN > **](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672531%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aCOIk0iIKORurDLwkl9R0w&sysid=1)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672532%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AtzuU1prYnc1GHXE1N7kjA&sysid=1)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

[ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672523%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xXYPF7cJWQCqn7M0UyAOWA&sysid=1)

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

| **_MIKE JOHNSON_**
* * *
Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana.

[**WILL YOU STAND WITH MIKE?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672533%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cGEXjmXuBeXcJSyYM%2bMUuQ&sysid=1)

As an immigrant to America, I know firsthand how difficult it can be for working families to get by.
But I've also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America — **and now, I'm running for Senate to safeguard those opportunities that self-serving politicians like my opponent, Rick Scott, want to destroy.**

My American Dream came true because my mother left our home in Ecuador and bravely brought my sisters and me to this country to give us a chance to build the future she dreamed of.

My American Dream came true because my mother worked day and night to afford rent in our one room apartment and provide us with a better education, a better home, and a better future.

I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

Friend,

You might not know me very well – _probably because I have been heads down working for the past seven years in Congress._

So, in my own words, I want to give you a chance to hear what I stand for.

**To my core, I believe the most important things are God, family, and country.**

**_I believe that God is not done with America yet._**

**I believe we need to unite as a party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is great – but I am bullish about the future of America.**

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

**I believe America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – _but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda on the rest of us._**

[**Last November, the American people put their faith in House Republicans and gave us a majority. We’ve been charged with holding Democrats accountable for their failure to get our country out of the malaise of their own making. To deliver on the promises we made, we need you on our team TODAY.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpi2np56hfulvu0q2pe7go44549jebrongvnnbeo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge2pj4c5h2bs)

Friend, I know it takes time to build trust; you’re getting to know me and I’m navigating this new role – but we must act – and quickly. We need a full course correction,**otherwise, I’m not sure what version of America we’ll hand down to the next generation.**

[**So, I’m asking you today – please commit to a donation of any amount. We will use your gift to help defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zggp0adm0ogg4i5u0pttjlnfg4gmcbshvqqh9e1g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge2pj4c5h2bs)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and I intend to keep that promise. [**Stand with me today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3g5fd0l79keba9mqfsskj72as9viv1g00b72bi0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge2pj4c5h2bs)

subject: I’m running to defeat Rick Scott

body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-dmp-split?amount=10?source=em231031-zm-dmp-split-90do&refcode2=547_8507_Xv8k7t&akid=547%2E8507%2EXv8k7t)

Folks,

My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. **And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. **The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.**

[_I've set an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it. Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Zak Malamed's right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-dmp-split?amount=10?source=em231031-zm-dmp-split-90do&refcode2=547_8507_Xv8k7t&akid=547%2E8507%2EXv8k7t)

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

---

When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.

Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.

**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**

Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on.

**That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November.** Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, we can take him down.

**So please, I’m personally asking:** [_Will you become a grassroots donor by splitting a gift between my campaign and Zak Malamed's today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-dmp-split?amount=10?source=em231031-zm-dmp-split-90do&refcode2=547_8507_Xv8k7t&akid=547%2E8507%2EXv8k7t)

The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet. Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage. My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life. Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on. That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, we can take him down. So please, I’m personally asking: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us. With gratitude, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

name: Mike Johnson
subject: The cornerstone of leadership
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35717%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jAusxxRdHiAlb61bQtbJig&sysid=1)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35718%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=z%2btXhaJ0PU%2fQmSyuMgljsA&sysid=1) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35719%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FFQIUUf02lAvXZWXaGHGGA&sysid=1)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35710%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0d2ib4s2z0pJ1lpXwvQLCA&sysid=1)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35711%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0wVUlS%2bgeqW%2fs4mPmWhEIw&sysid=1)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35712%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nccb844tGbhSDLz8QYGjag&sysid=1)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35713%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=r9oXswtgNac8nMjawedKug&sysid=1)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35714%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O2W2DDm%2bRQGe3b8AUOaZ5Q&sysid=1)

[** CHIP IN > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35725%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wtUjD8yGUGRIl8o%2bb5TDQw&sysid=1)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35726%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EHzcjGZN0v3NlnvC58papg&sysid=1)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35717%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jAusxxRdHiAlb61bQtbJig&sysid=1)

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

| **_MIKE JOHNSON_**
* * *
Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana.

[**WILL YOU STAND WITH MIKE?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35727%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rH3df1Un69yRhtV3Wr9ZJQ&sysid=1)

#

Good morning, Peter.
We’ve got an important deadline tomorrow at midnight. And it’s not lost on me that it’s on Halloween. So, rather than waste your time with some spooky email about “Scary Kari Lake” or anything like that, I wanted to look back at a few important dates...
**January 23, 2023**
That was the day I announced this campaign. At the time, all I knew was that Arizona deserved better than Kyrsten Sinema in the Senate. That was reason enough for me. I didn't know what to expect when I was preparing to announce. I wasn't sure what the reaction would be. But the outpouring of support was humbling to say the least.
The poor kid sleeping on the floor of a one bedroom apartment would have never guessed he'd be running for Senate, let alone with the support of so many people.
**October 10, 2023**
That’s the day Kari Lake launched her campaign. After our launch this is probably the most important day of the campaign so far, because that’s when the stakes became completely clear. That’s the day this race turned into something bigger. It used to be about flipping a seat in Arizona, holding the Senate. Now it is about saving our democracy itself.
**October 31, 2023**
That’s our end-of-month deadline. It’s also (obviously) Halloween. What that means is, folks probably aren’t going to be reading my emails. And that’s totally fine. But it’s an important deadline nonetheless, and we have to stay on top of our goals if we’re going to beat Lake and Sinema.
