Dear Peter,

I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just had to share it with you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72440163/435338403/-178630418?refcode=2310-OB-3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg1NmE0YWY5LTJhNzctZWUxMS1iMDA0LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AnOnw_U-o2eX6RZHWX1Qdl_T7_SxgppyqwxnCE5Vx78=)
I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

**Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask** — [ will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to split between Defeat Republicans and my campaign?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72440172/435338406/-178630418?refcode=2310-OB-3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg1NmE0YWY5LTJhNzctZWUxMS1iMDA0LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AnOnw_U-o2eX6RZHWX1Qdl_T7_SxgppyqwxnCE5Vx78=) If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)

While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.

These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.

And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

[If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in $15 to split between Defeat Republicans and my campaign.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/72440175/435338415/-178630418?refcode=2310-OB-3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg1NmE0YWY5LTJhNzctZWUxMS1iMDA0LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AnOnw_U-o2eX6RZHWX1Qdl_T7_SxgppyqwxnCE5Vx78=)

Tune in Now to the Doubt About It Podcast | | | | | |
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=eff5c2432c&e=567664f14c)
We have an urgent and eye-opening episode on the "No Doubt About It" podcast that you won't want to miss!

➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c1b2a91f4d&e=567664f14c)
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0ac6747f6a&e=567664f14c)

In this special edition, we are honored to welcome one of New Mexico's most effective sheriffs, Sheriff Mark Cage from Eddy County. **Sheriff Cage is known for his no-nonsense approach to addressing the crime issue in our state.** He pulls no punches in shedding light on the current crime crisis, and lays blame for the crime exactly where it belongs, at the feet of the legislature and governor. Sheriff Cage lays out in specific detail the fight to get the help they need from ineffective far left politicians in Santa Fe.
| [STREAM EPISODE 48 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=7ae183fc03&e=567664f14c)
---
**Sheriff Cage doesn't just identify the problems; he offers solutions.** One of his bold recommendations is clear: Arm yourself and learn how to use a firearm for personal protection. It's a stance that's sure to wake many people up.If you're concerned about the state of crime in New Mexico and want to hear from a respected law enforcement figure, this episode is a must-listen.
| [STREAM EPISODE 48 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c6b214dd47&e=567664f14c)
---

If you'd like to further support the No Doubt About It podcast, please consider checking out our store at [nodoubtaboutitpodcast.com](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8c15956f5d&e=567664f14c).

Thank you for being a part of our podcast community. We look forward to having you with us for this important discussion.

Best regards,Mark and Krysty Ronchetti

name: Mike Johnson
subject: The cornerstone of leadership
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zddv7b9appfgs1ke3c46bfhu2c1rere710c0b6i8_)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zevoir2gjuf9hlk9ek1ejkta6h9ons71sqj7se1g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge1o71cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7mnldh9eil9ma6gat6uqdmtr2tn2d2f62gdlk58_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge1o71cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfrk7jsu9ssd7ep7hou48q4qukmgafvhak430lgo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge1o71cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdkc8kf08gqc6tl7ehqg2pcps4l99rg89d6fmda0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60pj0ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6o70s3gm6oh5u)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvkrj4raeo40u2ea6int773pq02s6vepomsr28e0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdge1o71cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Best, Cammack Accounting Department \----- FWD MESSAGE ----- Sender: Kat Cammack Subject Line: Florida Conservatives have to work 2X as hard Preview Text: There’s a target on our backs Fellow Patriot, I respect you, so I’m going to shoot it to you straight. The left is raising money hand over fist, and Republicans are having a hard time keeping up. As a young, conservative woman from Florida – I’m exactly who the left despises, and they have their sights set on unseating me next November. So if you can, I need you to step up and help out as quickly as possible. | | | | | | We all know the economy is pretty bad right now, but it’s impacting some more than others. DC Elites, California millionaires, and New York City liberals are pretty much-living life as usual. They don’t know what it’s like to go to the grocery store and check the price of meat and bread, trying to find the most affordable option. But the hardworking, blue collar, Americans who support me are struggling – and they simply can’t give the way they used to. This is just the position the left wants us to be in – on the back foot and unable to fight back against the destruction of American values. But we can’t give up the fight. We have to work twice as hard. No matter what you can give, the most important thing is that you act right now. Thank you, | | Rep. name: Jay Jones
subject: Our Senate Majority is going to come down to the wire
body:
Friend,
I'll cut straight to the chase - our majority in the Senate is going to come down to the wire next week.
Redistricting has thrown conventional wisdom out the window and could put our already slim 22-18 Democratic majority at risk. Senate Democrats have been a brick wall against Republican extremist attempts to turn back the clocks on a woman's right to choose and the common sense gun safety measures I've worked tirelessly for.
Simply put, we can't afford any slip ups.
So will you please split a donation between the Senate Democratic Caucus and my efforts today so we can ensure our brick wall stays intact? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jayjones-senatedems?refcode=20231030]
Thanks for fighting with me.
- Jay

* One of my opponents attended a Kansans for Life Political Action Committee event

While all that is going on in KS-03, we’re seeing the effects of House GOP leadership in Congress: After weeks of infighting, my House GOP colleagues elected a new Speaker who has never held a leadership position in Congress before and is best known for his support of the Big Lie that the 2020 election was stolen, despite the total lack of evidence.

**As Speaker, he’s expected to push for a total abortion ban to pass in the House, as well as cuts to Medicare and Social Security.**

I ran for Congress because I am dedicated to showing up for you and will continue to advocate for Kansans like you. I'm not in Congress for self-serving interests or to make the biggest news headline. Unlike many of the House’s GOP members, I'm not playing around.

I'm fighting for your freedoms and to make life better for the Third District. And this is what I'm here to do every single day.

With the election happening in almost exactly a year, it's really time for us to gear up and be ready for any attacks or obstacles that are going to come our way up through Election Day. Grassroots supporters like you are the reason I've been able to get this far, and I believe you can help us keep pushing through.

Help us reach our $13,000 goal by making a $20 donation today.

Thank you,

Sharice

name: Mike Johnson
subject: The cornerstone of leadership
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR
BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWf1ju6iND

Mike Johnson for Congress

I believe to my core that the most important things in
life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the
values that guide me...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWf1ju6iND

Fellow American,

The most important things in life
are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these
happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I
am fighting every day to preserve them.

Faith. Our nation began with the
bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that
our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders
insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity
because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality
are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many
American households through the generations, in our house we
instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve
people.

Family. Stable, happy families
are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should
always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear
family should be a top priority, and government should get out of
the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very
intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor,
and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them
along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been
the American way.

Freedom. It is a self-evident
truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as
the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience,
and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth
and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government
is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always
aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people.
I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental
freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a
constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

This is a simple truth: America
is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the
history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are
led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who
we are!

SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON >

Right now in America, children
are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country
and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because
it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right
before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective
abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected,
unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every
aspect of our lives.

This is simply un-American, and
we must stop the madness.

We must elect more leaders who
make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God,
family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings
we have been given here.

Today, to continue to help lead
this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore
our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation
immediately?

DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA >

Fellow American, we have a chance
to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to
destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what
version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down
this path. We simply must make a change before it's too late.

I made a promise when I was first
elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana,
and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted
ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical
positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was
elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House
Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions
for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on
the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary
Committee.

We are working in Congress every
day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for
freedom, but we cannot do it alone.

If you are committed to keeping
the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and
want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your
support today.

CHIP IN >

The path we're on currently will
lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We
still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF
conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT
NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so
today.

Can you pitch in right now to
help save our country, Fellow American?

Thank you for all you do, and God
bless.

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

MIKE JOHNSON
Mike is a dedicated
husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law
attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the
fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been
a priority to the people of Louisiana.

WILL YOU STAND WITH
MIKE?

PAID FOR
BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA

My mom and dad were out, and I thought I’d get some rest on the big bed. But since I was so excited, I accidentally closed the door behind me, and it locked. And since I don’t have any thumbs, I was stuck in the people's bedroom.
I was scared at first, but a man eventually came with a big ladder and climbed in through the window. I was happy to get out!

After his recent embarrassing removal as Speaker of the House, California Republican Congressman Kevin McCarthy is now facing a credible primary challenge from an America First candidate named David Giglio.
Speaking exclusively to Laura Loomer on Sunday evening, the night before officially publishing his press release in which he announced his candidacy, Mr. Giglio says Kevin McCarthy has spent years in Washington serving nobody but himself.
"This campaign is about taking the fight directly to the corrupt uniparty's front steps," Giglio said to Loomer. "When we defeat Kevin, the GOP establishment will finally know that the Republican party belongs to President Trump and his MAGA movement."
"Kevin McCarthy has spent years pretending to be an ally for President Trump while undermining him behind the scenes every chance he gets," Giglio continued. "Just follow his money. Follow his votes. Follow his actions."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/09570f6e-663f-445c-bd80-228904e1ba81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Giglio rightly believes that McCarthy is nothing more than a used car salesman who will say and do anything for power and money.
David Giglio officially filed paperwork with the FEC Sunday evening to run for US Congress in California's 20th Congressional District, which includes Bakersfield to Fresno.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2a02417d-e758-4832-86b1-0c3e9ebff981?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"When President Trump wins next year, he needs real allies fighting beside him so we can finally defeat the Uniparty, dismantle the deep state, drain the swamp, and put America First," Giglio said.
"Despite owing his entire speakership to President Trump, McCarthy refuses to endorse Trump for re-election in 2024. If that is not a sign that he is a snake, then nothing is," Giglio continued. "It is not only a betrayal of President Trump, but also a betrayal of the Republican base around the country. We must drain the swamp, one race, one representative, and one former speaker at a time!"
"MAGA must not just be satisfied with ousting Kevin as speaker," Giglio said. "Now it's time to send him home to retire in Frank Luntz's basement where he belongs!"
David Giglio will be joining Laura Loomer for an exclusive video interview on Tuesday's edition of Loomer Unleashed at 8:30 pm EST on October 31st to talk about why he is primarying Kevin McCarthy.

Earning the confidence and support of community members, leaders, and business people is what distinguishes Maria Montero--she reflects the people, values, and work ethic of the 7th Congressional District in Pennsylvania.

This week, we are pleased to share the support of former Republican Pennsylvania Lt. Governor Candidate, James Jones. Mr. Jones is a Conservative business leader whose run for LG expanded the base of the Republican Party. Maria is the new face of the GOP and she represents a key to grow our our party amongst the 55,000 Latino voters who live in PA's 7th Congressional District. Many Latino voters are shifting toward the Republican party and Mr. Jones knows Maria is the best candidate to beat Susan Wild. "Maria has the charisma, Conservative values, and real-world experience to win PA-7. I have been on board with Maria since Day 1, I believe in her, pray for her, and know that the future of our Conservative movement depends on us electing Maria Montero for Congress in PA-7". Thank you James for your support!

body:
I hope you’ll join me on Team Tchenko. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c385cee8a680/a-new-way-forward-for-texas-12659035?e=b8ba94fd9b)
---
Peter,
My name’s Carla Schoonover Porter and I’m the Palo Pinto County Democratic Party Chair.
[**I’m writing today to ask you to support my friend Thierry for the U.S. Senate and to join me on Team Tchenko.**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=c077f644ea&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Thierry and his wife Gloria have been traveling rural Texas for months, with nothing more than their family car and their message that A New Way Forward is possible.
The “consultants” tell him that he is wasting his time – that he should spend his time only in the big cities asking big donors for big money.
_But that’s not Thierry. And it’s not the campaign he’s running._
He’s traveling everywhere throughout the state talking to anyone and everyone who will listen to him about his vision of A New Way Forward for Texas.
Having spent a lot of time getting to know him these last few months, I can tell you that he is the real deal. You know when you meet someone that is different and special... someone who has a servant's heart? You just know!
He is smart, kind, compassionate, AND he has a plan for Texas. Lord knows we need him.

[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=f41e2ae38d&e=b8ba94fd9b)
[**Kick in $20.24 or more today and join me in supporting this awesome grassroots campaign that’s going to defeat Ted Cruz and create A New Way Forward.**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=96976614df&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Most politicians want your help. Thierry is constantly looking for ways to help us!I am loudly and proudly a member of Team Tchenko and I will be supporting Thierry in the upcoming Democratic Primary for the U.S. Senate.
**I know him to be the best candidate to support and represent Rural Texans. Please join me in supporting Thierry with a donation of $20.24 or more today.**

I hope this message finds you well. Early voting begins tomorrow Saturday, October 28th - Sunday, November 5th.
You can vote at any designated early voting center in Suffolk County. If you are unsure about where to vote on Election Day \- Tues., Nov. 7th, visit the NYS Board of Elections website: [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010h4IAu8wSm_nuclQH_ycA4QJd9K1ySnoxx5r38razKX7sKejFrB2rRACRWmWl4iLGFQwgCQdLLBRZ9rUhuwYZexzXP82olkcUYpDtSWbf7N3GWJ0OB_FNDUG6lw72mTBbCmT4LL5a0CaF2lj9_6DiKDz4WAFlDkK&c=DWwv7zDMb6KzCCKzFTnk0iJjf-X0_VWN2or6PDe40ScZYoNhEzqS3A==&ch=re2NDFveOAFNGeDHlccbVM-PNJmFHeXa0qmuXqqF-xWDuyHt3dJOnA==).
It will be honor to represent the people of Suffolk County's 5th District...
I will advance policies that focus on putting families first and work to make Suffolk a better place for our children and future generations.

### Week Two in Trial: Fair Fight et al v. True the Vote et al
On Thursday, October 26th, our trial began in a lawsuit filed against us by Fair Fight, Stacey Abrams, and Marc Elias, with the Biden Justice Department having intervened. [This case has been ongoing since December 2020.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD9aspWv3_CzE1fXyaE6ysvHZQ9ujLX6pAqbaN_Gy3Bf-m9pyLdZHogCk1V8FXt_vnAWss6rZicR8gMiqaf6JptMDxJXQl8o_g7KNSm6l-WdPzwLmgNxVNj3KJ14EhK0Yd8vyxxQ67IAXgTLNPTKFaJNYzBRXQj2-A0wk1bou9GEo7iXq1z3hJ_jzZ2_XPcKbe0/40v/fBLIz6ghTUCITaQt8opq0g/h2/m8XvweVboKClL7IacxeUhwiMqgFGak4eUeDs12ePMps)
A short background ... in 2020, True the Vote helped Georgia citizens lawfully provide information about ineligible voter records to their counties. Over 364,000 records were identified. For our efforts, Stacey Abrams, Marc Elias, and the Biden Justice Department sued me, True the Vote, and five Georgia citizens who I’d thanked by name in a press statement.
Mainstream media has been all over this. [ New York Times](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/SCyHX0Wroz1z7wbvqPM-jC5njmGPsZRAFL9Nc2MPBNuFBxhaYmNlH9QSohLC4av9fgjYsN8Bp326SfvWHXnKYQHX8iAvPpP_NBNwSU7FIOG7F9LKvGNYNRxusGoJ7O5J8_PyDEOGheT43zjO_GoDwdo9lf4J_6X4DbLuQDPJofggbHe4EjMgf7lZL9zqhvpgrLetJGIB-8abg45jOkQliw/40v/fBLIz6ghTUCITaQt8opq0g/h3/XyeFxn8HFl6si_s1TguoEAzQhNlJjNsXdB-tZ-RejtU), [AP](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/4xkviejVe2bcNHdbmWFEFgOmGlRoLj5Wgf0D17XRTSfq9szvDIay2MoAXi44N3751GTCVk7o579-upuenf-KW_exc0mquUTZevDMLy12tzIVF1Pc7QMKRB-U9Ntd1yoPEPDYBv5baHSdZCPstqNdoRflzPa1A82KBUXnjwuRxbAApxfUlXXkqKOMTohReYmccZspCal9Qd8FV4YwfNxn9KK-Pjopx8PKp9a4KylJnjaEk0L1iOTkxVWIrxR26g4b1H7WuIV4svfwtAd4V4GZtfHLb54Rpn-22uSv_cv93XqleWfUoHuKyPluJylP_Pst/40v/fBLIz6ghTUCITaQt8opq0g/h4/T_tUXEAXUoDCMufxQWvJOeoAYneEq-17njhW1mitFFk), and [Atlanta Journal Constitution](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsRMsfC-2PTsr_wiNivxO0t0vrpocvzL8mjV-p6XAXldktr46Q0L1eFYeXbJJXpciKTrnJc1VPn5DyOnXaNOutQpjYkhprPC3evcu5QLyRsm_R2KgjDlZ94XDTJAyjE9aZxqnGJ3L12WrdYoE1p1-GFQhWY7rou5SNeZZosvIls4Bw23u2qbKKbCl4PxrDv8TTaq-hgmR0T5eOjNqomUw6jeh4NA5_hSV-B85iUaeprsSedNi1NZMTQpDtZ926TIWzXrxt2WTlQ06yB9SmpkVwez4rKq-5BfmsYyjzIe93NqTPDNKN6xig_IwVaFZbiC7Mw/40v/fBLIz6ghTUCITaQt8opq0g/h5/pt543Eo1yBL5_1zjYP4YwLa_9_Lg9UgoyrOAsCk4sTE), to list just a few. And, as you would guess, the coverage has been largely negative.
Despite the inaccurate details and biased framing, they are right about one thing, this is a landmark case. We are fighting to protect citizens’ rights, your rights, to engage in electoral processes.
If we were not standing this ground, groups like Fair Fight would continue to bully citizens into silence. We must retain the right to engage, assemble, and lawfully petition our government - and in elections, we must strive to true the vote!
#### Join Me Tomorrow Night for An Update from the Ground in Georgia
[This Monday night, 10.30, at 7p et](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/1A5_Z39fk90fowLbTa71p8CcvqgWD5nu5ue1tPC3yY7DuvypUMGP0Oern9eq83VrG0gMQptg7Hy0OVmfk8ADEZF0e2Ua5VG6gPO5_ZGZeDhLXj5xw6YYICyOWZBcPBza8KNvLjWJPlOwAgLNyJVKHYc2_3-VWyCbD_1xXfT0VhIl97ZVTxchQ-5sqZScylrcQqb_yGltqZqYwQ0ce36oCyB6D6OxoF1m-Cz2UWMibTo1bvPj6ar0ZBt33Ho-U3tIG49F9vl9SnwuxHTVLluOnWoUW_as5w7U47Zjr7ye4alC18PumhCOFJvG5XztxV7r/40v/fBLIz6ghTUCITaQt8opq0g/h6/8wgH1mwBhnnEPNbLr7WnBrbXSzoDwYw8izTnbetKDyM), we’ll recap all the events of the trial and reflect on all that has happened in various courtrooms over the past year - it’s a lot. Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgb177c5s39jfocuae108dog0admh5gv2tj56a50_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmmn2r7mjsqe77j1lo3q9bqigvn77icok729pep0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0fhdtagpbbtmvhtrb9htli7u7bqrsv45goonfio_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqfj4u6r0p2rf0trmk5ekk9m7bvv8osv31gg5rp8_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgmvkqb2fv7je6bnrvtmdpfiv6a5attd1ua0n74g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9fntmqthg3g19tgtamou5f5die8c28qh990m8jo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrhph8hapkmtq6lvabraquhfigurkda5qivpfvh8_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie4ob6c3h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Mike Johnson, who led the House effort to overturn the 2020 election results, also happens to have been a fierce opponent of my efforts to investigate and impeach Donald Trump.** Tom Emmer voted to certify the 2020 election result. The Senate is working on big spending bills (a monstrous supplemental that Mitch McConnell and Biden both want) that tie aid to Israel to aid to Ukraine to the border (which isn’t even real border security – it’s money to facilitate _more_ resettlement) to everything else. Alternatively, the House Republicans are going to work to pass a paid-for, standalone Israel aid package. Our call to action this week is to support the House Republicans in this effort to pass the standalone Israel bill, and begin putting pressure on the Senate to take it up and pass it once it has passed the House. | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

# In The News....
John made appearances on a number of television shows to talk about the importance of revitalizing education in Maryland; and continued to share insights on the Israel-Hamas war, tensions in the Middle East, and various concerns here in the United States, leaning on his decades of experience as a leader in the U.S. Air Force, a father, a small business owner, and a mentor for sound leadership all around the world.

#
Derek,
Look, this isn’t an easy email for us to write.
We were high speed here for a few months, taking the fight to Tommy Tuberville, leading the work to get our senior promotions filled.
We got real results. Three seats in the Joint Chiefs of Staff are filled now — including the Chairman. Democrats are working on procedures to force the GOP to approve more.
But ever since we filled those 3 seats, attention crashed — and so has our fundraising. Folks aren’t paying attention. We don’t know if it’s because we’re getting closer to the holidays, or if it’s because folks think this isn’t as important any more, or some other reason.
Whatever the reason, this is not great. We have good women and men down in the field. We will not leave them behind. We are in this fight until the job is done.
With conflict boiling over around the world, we need the right people in the right seats. It’s beyond readiness now, it’s beyond our National Security. The entire world is at risk if the United States is not ready. Like it or not, we remain the indispensable power on the world stage. We have to keep up the pressure.
[**So please. We need you to join the 1% of VoteVets supporters who have made a donation and chip in today. A donation of any amount, to keep us in the fight. To get these promotions moving. Susan already has four Republican opponents vying for the nomination to defeat her.

And even with the primary election still months away, they are raising some serious money to try and defeat Susan next year.

_Regardless of who Susan faces in the general election, we need to be prepared for anything and everything._

subject: Important Food Shortage Notice
body:
This might be your only warning.

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf9n2g36vm3vu080hi66bsnc9cd1s0jsoe81jomg_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h2bs). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zkau09ub95vh0hba7j5bi9knopf7mks4bb08i29g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h2bs) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0u1ms5q3mll878ahl53tla3kec2sq7kgvteu7hg_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h2bs) on these survival food kits while you can.

name: Mike Johnson
subject: America is the greatest country on earth
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1ma94caru96ouhkfgi211nc6lgt1s2fohsqq0so_)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdgnkdq5sidcsf116rvlv1gnnqi2lvcjo4k14ve0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl4m2jap94p5e5qrfkbm6ni9c56liiaq4o32cpi60pj0ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6p71c9i61oh5u) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zk13v8kcit318n67o60n49il81uio4kdc8iotiv8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl4m2jap94p5e5qrfkbm6ni9c56liiaq4o32cpi60pj0ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6p71c9i61oh5u)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbk1r6frf58e043sqomm5oi2e4aa4jes28ggdbao_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt3du56b0s0h3sl0n7hbre64gjvd3s9vfglard50_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjcq8aj7bqor7h76062v7eec856ujvaljqh70ugo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl4m2jap94p5e5qrfkbm6ni9c56liiaq4o32cpi60pj0ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6p71c9i61oh5u)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9e927fe5iladnffgpukagms587aeep2sotm1e38_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc8vpndkceaqh02td8gjkss21dnba5pgefqghq68_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie2oj4c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30cpg669bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[** CHIP IN > **](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za69vv03u8n55jj6v4g87ugjaocg9vibho5mhtn8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl4m2jap94p5e5qrfkbm6ni9c56liiaq4o32cpi60pj0ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6p71c9i61oh5u)

clean_body: I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life. | Fellow American, The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7232f9371dde4091b3059e5151d6b44f&_e=4a0iMlYA7asUK6mIYhaTj_z458Jm9nmsGpWCBw6AW_JyfGqhxpAqlsxMhTX-o6Zn6tZVyqufg_hNglA9XXHtRL6XnpoCWQ1xrhaFlhDjf69QFcOGJ4gxUUPFjH9apgYKJAhdxTsSOqdnmw7FoMw0BLo-HJhpUBDJe-cDFZ9k0EglLclJUWnEM1veZRka3tQGwQpIn8QsfJE43JaBkt8D0di0Ic0hCbS0hrp-ufdvmvIwN3BOlx21_GEhBC0JfX3jfKI-2fp3gGw8MDwutZjwSY0KqTKb-TnBSWoHWjErkBV17joem9CXyGWG06Bhjykw5ZyStdlX318w_Y2oWry-ln0ZxgqetokhLxH37M_TzX8gzYWhpoimyKBnHqNJRA56) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7232f9371dde4091b3059e5151d6b44f&_e=4a0iMlYA7asUK6mIYhaTj_z458Jm9nmsGpWCBw6AW_JyfGqhxpAqlsxMhTX-o6Zn6tZVyqufg_hNglA9XXHtRL6XnpoCWQ1xrhaFlhDjf69QFcOGJ4gxUUPFjH9apgYKJAhdxTsSOqdnmw7FoMw0BLo-HJhpUBDJe-cDFZ9k0EglLclJUWnEM1veZRka3tQGwQpIn8QsfJE43JaBkt8D0di0Ic0hCbS0hrp-ufdvmvKtPnLLABe7yUpjp7Ix7AvPT2JmC7E1v-CEpq3r_3OqkYIkuK3y9S5z-1FNLymAyNWVJ-gqwHngaPQntDqZe7er4tgHj-EC7ZtNBhYbaUUBiLhJf81-x7PZZJ4pate1hH6VaNriQz7BCd7GAZ_tftaq)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7232f9371dde4091b3059e5151d6b44f&_e=4a0iMlYA7asUK6mIYhaTj_z458Jm9nmsGpWCBw6AW_JyfGqhxpAqlsxMhTX-o6Zn6tZVyqufg_hNglA9XXHtRL6XnpoCWQ1xrhaFlhDjf69QFcOGJ4gxUUPFjH9apgYKJAhdxTsSOqdnmw7FoMw0BLo-HJhpUBDJe-cDFZ9k0EglLclJUWnEM1veZRka3tQGwQpIn8QsfJE43JaBkt8D0di0Ic0hCbS0hrp-ufdvmvIe0WYWmYxAiBlyEfbBw0jsKPCA3V53dEjS6JW57R9QeKLRTPelp43FcV0BwgT51Q2haTSX-w2RbK1GDNWVmcEpsG3dTEx6MtmwwRHSfmBJCTEk9Y6aEQphFr4tArOsPlWaMjzT7HP3qLbWMrj6m0NC)

clean_body: I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life. | Fellow American, The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, The path we're on currently will lead us to destruction. name: Mike Johnson
subject: Let me introduce myself
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
|

|
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._e_1IZx6w)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world – but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-t17GZ0LvFimQ)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-JPaNY0yF2rg)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it's too late.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-DFXOQUkpjHw)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

[** CHIP IN > **](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

The path we're on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

| ** _MIKE JOHNSON_**
* * *
Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana.

[**WILL YOU STAND WITH MIKE?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
