body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq9srh03662s6aqea9l0035cm95b888pqrnrr9k8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r3kthqep238h1e8he4933cjge6p73c1h6eoh5u)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z57ulseeefl1j21g5f0lgljbvai3afq2212ns1k8_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie6o32cth238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqga174p5e5qrfkbm6ni184slk9g64pj4c1j60op5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls9qj6sp5e5qrfldl64qbatdlskqr8d5hmcin2tdnqoq3bc3k6irj7df26irr3kti4no) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcfaohoh9gklvumucj2ll8ps1dvo0ukumhuo0np0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie6o32cth238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqga174p5e5qrfkbm6ni184slk9g64pj4c1j60op5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls9qj6sp5e5qrfldl64qbatdlskqr8d5hmcin2tdnqoq3bc3k6irj7df26irr3kti4no)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvlgiuapfs6enb0ukva7fhnufcskl6t5c853s4g0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1or4sdg64pr24no)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpudumguqbq1d1ouom6dp8ffgaamr6l8oj4iqr6g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie6o32cth238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqga174p5e5qrfkbm6ni184slk9g64pj4c1j60op5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls9qj6sp5e5qrfldl64qbatdlskqr8d5hmcin2tdnqoq3bc3k6irj7df26irr3kti4no)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z609jqa2pvn1a2vau10ksfda32eirkqh7ks97gvo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sdie6o32cth238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqga174p5e5qrfkbm6ni184slk9g64pj4c1j60op5e5qrfljnmlp7cd9ls9qj6sp5e5qrfldl64qbatdlskqr8d5hmcin2tdnqoq3bc3k6irj7df26irr3kti4no)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl8joqg49ippkfgmm2kbh835ivnjrivonpd6fe88_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1or4sdg64pr24no)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2spil9kklkvn2vm8os2ajolc9rucmvoo178h9ao_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1or4sdg64pr24no)

[** CHIP IN > **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjlurahfeb1ahrgof41kghj51pvoj299gee5c2vg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1or4sdg64pr24no)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8paollu8chhj64kmd222ba3gfoi7q4nakil14to_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl0k2e9iasblmv8ncdf42g9pb8j0c9j68o36c1hiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1or4sdg64pr24no)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: LGBTQ+ History Month - sharing some of my thoughts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hi friends, October is LGBTQ+ History Month. Throughout this month, I’ve reflected on its significance - and the real and lived experiences our friends and loved ones in this community are facing - and I didn’t want to let the month end without sharing some thoughts with you.
The history of the LGBTQ+ community in this country is one of resilience and resistance - of fighting for the right to simply exist, to love freely and openly, and to be guaranteed the same legal rights and protections as everyone else.
This month, we remember some of the most pivotal moments in this struggle - like the Stonewall riots that ignited the modern LGBTQ+ rights movement, the assassination of Harvey Milk, and the suffering this community endured at the hands of our government’s inaction during the AIDS epidemic.
And we celebrate the incredible progress we’ve made - like the 2015 landmark Supreme Court decision that made marriage equality the law of the land, the repeal of “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” in our military, and the passage of the Respect for Marriage Act just last year.
But this month is also an important opportunity to reflect on whether we’re living up to our values and doing everything we can to ensure the LGBTQ+ community can access the same opportunities to thrive - and feel the same acceptance, love, and safety as the rest of us.
To truly acknowledge and celebrate LGBTQ+ History Month, we have to be clear-eyed about the bigotry that is spreading across the country, and commit to working against it. Trans and gender non-conforming Americans are being targeted by outrageous, hateful legislation in statehouses across the country, and in Washington, D.C., my GOP colleagues just installed an anti-LGBTQ+ extremist as Speaker of the House.
We have to fight back against this rising violence and hatred. There’s no other way forward. I’m committed to celebrating, standing with, and working to protect the LGBTQ+ community not just this month, but every day of the year. I hope you’re with me.
Thanks for being here and for reading to the end. I’m grateful to stand side by side with you in this fight.
-Sara

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=22a2b20ff1844a48a27f4399da606715&_e=9pkiPvYVFP5PXxi376bolgbSf3gFEarW8q9S-0jTZBQqflMkwlAVYAT8SeeZZ9nkrxFbCcQaoVG3IVIHBMs2iG0VAWRYB4kG40FEebeML7-lmBpctbEZ-vG9IaPV4nPjn9h9Txvet99uRUdX9Q6G0LVFVNCso_xrCV7lY2q6CztdANMXc2trM7o1n8eW9fpR7SSZXoRF4zDSrNUlcBmhaQYfRLfuv_5h6CDxTb3EEjxHvTgp0UiLlF1AExnW5kn-iH51GyhnmvKvgrsxRFJNkHC4JadIvfp4ghHonX95PyTb0hsq_x4wpdxv8amJCRogiL06E0OlgoOjJTaD44gusqvNkfxz9HumkjeL6eRIRUdOHBvNe5VHgmYxMkeeyFCM)

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=22a2b20ff1844a48a27f4399da606715&_e=9pkiPvYVFP5PXxi376bolgbSf3gFEarW8q9S-0jTZBQqflMkwlAVYAT8SeeZZ9nkrxFbCcQaoVG3IVIHBMs2iG0VAWRYB4kG40FEebeML7-lmBpctbEZ-vG9IaPV4nPjn9h9Txvet99uRUdX9Q6G0LVFVNCso_xrCV7lY2q6CztdANMXc2trM7o1n8eW9fpR7SSZXoRF4zDSrNUlcBmhaQYfRLfuv_5h6CDxTb3EEjylT79P5zDaVDjxqUdvvZtXKxToJRYjbwFX5dj9pDTUgIljdpbSQB0veozxmomprR4K8asV_pxjpKN1hsk_eJ9thW_IOjiZbeD7yBEQp4LRkuidXSQUz6DlRSLnMPugsPwESspYPWSsjsaDvRqfCVhW) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

# **Talking to voters, working on short session and Free Hugs**
---
Friends,As we move into winter and the snow starts covering the mountains I wanted to drop an email to discuss a couple of things happening in House District 59 and Eastern Oregon. I hope your hunting season so far has been successful and the wood cutting is going strong for winter fires! __Personal note:__ recently I stepped down as the House Republican Leader. Leading the other Representatives in Salem is a ton of work and comes with a lot of criticism from both sides of the aisle. I can handle the criticism all day long, but Bryan and I operate many small companies and the ranch and there is really only so much time to go around. I enjoyed my two years as leader and proud of my accomplishments for Republicans in Oregon. I also get to spend quality time with my two boys in their final years in High School. Alex has already decided to attend Grand Canyon University in Phoenix starting in Fall 2024. **_I am still running for House District 59 at a minimum and will be your Representative in 2024 and beyond. Now I will have more time to dedicate to issues around our district. _** __Town Halls__ \- On that note, recently I did a town hall in Redmond, Madras and Prineville. Two of those with Senator Findley who also represents us. We had a great turnout at all the locations with some very good conversations around many topics. There will be more coming in Terrebonne, Crooked River Ranch, Culver and Sisters in the coming months so stay tuned for dates on those events. I think most of the conversation centered around Measure 110, inflation issues and Portland centered problems creating havoc around the state. It is clear in Oregon, we can not detach ourselves from the problems Portland creates in every county in Oregon. More of that further down the page. __2024 Short Session__ \- On the issue of Measure 110, the Legislature made a special committee controlled by them via a majority of members on the committee (it is not bipartisan when they have a 3 vote majority on a committee). This committee will have hearings to basically hear from special interest groups bent on keeping drugs legal in Oregon so non profits can reap millions in solving a problem in which only 20% of drug users even want. **_I believe we need a full repeal of Measure 110_. Anything short of making hard drugs illegal and throwing people in jail so they can get sober then decide to get treatment will not affect the problem**. Our other major issue will be housing. I am now the Vice-Chair of Housing Committee and will be working with the Governor's office and Senator Dick Anderson who is the Senate Vice- Chair of Housing to come up with real solutions. I am excited by the opportunity to get some real changes done so our home builders can get some "sticks in the air". All levels of housing is needed in Oregon. We will roll up our sleeves and get to work on this one. Locally, I have been having discussions with Pahlisch Homes and Hayden Homes to make sure what we are working on will actually work for builders and realtors. Lastly, we have some budget issues to work on in Salem. Oregon does not have a tax problem, the state coffers are full and we need to get some dollars to local governments on shovel ready projects like roads, water facilities, and sewer lines. It is a must to focus on actual infrastructure improvements, not some non-profit black hole. And while I am at it, you bet we will be asking ODOT why they are building bike lanes but not plowing our mountain passes this winter. __Greater Idaho__ \- Recently, we traveled to Baker City (great town by the way and we stayed at the Geiser Grand which is a gem in Oregon) to have a meeting with some of my Idaho Representatives to discuss the Greater Idaho movement. This was not an official visit, but I have met some of Idaho Representatives at my national meetings this past year and felt I needed to have a further discussion on the idea. My state inbox has been flooded with people living in my district asking me to have these discussions about Greater Idaho. __I believe it is my duty as your Representative to have the discussions at the minimum regardless of the issue__ or how I believe, if that many people reach out and ask me to listen, I am there. [_https://www.kmvt.com/2023/10/22/greater-idaho-leaders-met-with-oregon-idaho-representatives-discuss-next-move/_](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AXMAACmlQHIAAAALx84AAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABlP94HAnQQj7kwSUO5eJiUXRuaiQAasDI/1/Q1EQoQn5dAjQW65TqtgKCQ/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cua212dC5jb20vMjAyMy8xMC8yMi9ncmVhdGVyLWlkYWhvLWxlYWRlcnMtbWV0LXdpdGgtb3JlZ29uLWlkYWhvLXJlcHJlc2VudGF0aXZlcy1kaXNjdXNzLW5leHQtbW92ZS8) There is much to do but it was a good conversation. 12 counties have voted in favor of having these discussions. I am not sure where they will go with it all, but it is apparent that Eastern Oregonians do not feel like they have the same values as Portland or Eugene. Pretty much similar for all Oregonians living in the rural parts of the state. I hope at the very least, the Greater Idaho Movement will lead to better discussions with the Governor and other elected officials on the other side of the mountain.

# _**Free Hugs with Ken Nwadike, Jr. - inspiration**_
---
| Just recently, I had the amazing opportunity to listen to Ken Nwadike who started the [_Free Hugs project_](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AXMAACmlQHIAAAALx84AAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABlP94HAnQQj7kwSUO5eJiUXRuaiQAasDI/3/vzNPXm3laHPWp9F2qvegTg/aHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlaHVnc3Byb2plY3QuY29tLw) at a Windermere event, Bryan and I went to as Windermere owners. (The job I do when not serving as State Representative). Wow, was I moved by his story and mission in life. The passion he has for people is beyond what I have seen lately and it really moved me. Ken grew up homeless, went on to college running track, created the hollywood marathon and then the Free Hugs Project... You must check out his website at [_www.freehugsproject.com_](https://026s4.mjt.lu/lnk/AXMAACmlQHIAAAALx84AAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABlP94HAnQQj7kwSUO5eJiUXRuaiQAasDI/4/OU7HTvCUp78UGVUntLu0dA/aHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlaHVnc3Byb2plY3QuY29tLw) there are a lot of videos and other things about him. He has been a Nike ambassador for running and just puts himself in the middle of conflict looking for common ground. Thank you Ken for inspiring me.
---

This means any contribution you make will be twice as effective. Send $100 today and it becomes $200! Send $50 and it becomes $100. Send $500 and we will get there in no time...Let's keep pushing for balance in Oregon. I look forward to working with you, and for you, over the next two years.Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| **Vikki Breese-Iverson **
**Proud Mom, Realtor and Rancher**
**Oregon State Representative for HD 59**

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~ "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hABvyhrIJfiXym8FLpfZ-g~~/AARclAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf9-gi7ct5HmfodvNeTFntZHh2H4VtslDq42xIv7Zk8YjInv_lwwrSJB7KdSd0ekdn0LEUsWt-ICssP4lutnZTaYNXgKbu8vbI7LO1LCyyJvBxxbdcg6ferN_3qOqFFLPdtMseHzJVotF5LCf319Sb7v)

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf9_E-JqoE0Dt0WAILdknH12hTnTuoF2dl496CYymtejdTvlnFGyBuK6XNPRS0poQOnJwxoBuyGNb8WJhouBmjncP0L3ibmK2DnCbcx0XzfHut4x2rek-I_ib4ftid7sClk0H5aY3Nri-iUxeuhopfGt) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf_IkcxC50Q82Kmy7HT5yLExLbeTLMjo8UAeDH607Cc40zq1hPrHku1zvE7vJKYjsQeZgpDA4BWsuqnFvni-aSSR25o9XEh7-r8FhRihxcgvwBCW4W7kteDL-dsYzBMjiBY-1c2bhR6Pc62G6sxZ5Npt)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf9DnsqVVGTQZHW7YcP0xbWvmjfM7u1xvNHGUluWu_vVDvlBVjaIyDG4sFAPQy4Fy1Dq_kb9VRlPPaRklxRcqoXA9aKJQeTRkn4RNdDSmSxLfJm-9tjjKb_dGUIfm-e6nyLRruTDeRCRlomLzIlCOITe)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf9J3YMGogSqoMkEw5bsy5pT81cLBaa320KZLMGf8-F0fIr8T-F_2s_otue-mcUQwFIefv04plNR8oci37fuSdLeSVpH-8pjCwFUPoHOU_StXVPiXv6-pje078yXrivVRlC319PJ8URnFiPThQ6frXsP)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it 's too late.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf8Zi3N3H3XjqUgq-OLnMzwRRlXdOyICXrPbQhpcCmP3a04nxB7qdysipC8zFDQcFGPqwBXLudWDaR2xSltxUojxGM8xngjbedBbdGhDTOI_dt66cQzLUi0GwUgqf5dEpZIEND4VyMDTwn4M6QeZJY0b)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf_VJHH5-fHmZLRrSALjg0ZlLXyWnbR3OF3z_iAj4eT87aCZs5hZvinmmWHISeDi2h3ACYnYxpPXK2f9qDXlWSlLua1CYkFaCR1FO8r2-YIgAbx_dmC0GGjauxCJgJ2nCKGxCa9GLRojcMpF9VwWbSsV)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf-BLItXxqPYFxDzxD6vy55z1Z0mZpqHwWp9-suWCxcr5AsRQeUfqZqjPrlHbdJQguz4XPMN2wb8JTsSmwyrA_OgK136OPeWX7_bptGIu11zRBRFyRLY7CI4I84A0IfcTLQAgwtSd66TYr26Xs2oajXS)

[** CHIP IN > **](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c8daf9a98b9b4c4d9694c4155bbb2773&_e=Kg3H9Z1M2b0tzZr0JdA9RBPsPj5EjVYfSS6OVji2az3LKaax9GicipA3-roSYevK4MlBsOtw6UAbY7Tph2XBN8z2RfAKa4y_7VfOa0AGgNDGR-zxdQMx_vgtetHPlgnq2BXI_KPc4c_yF1pbVtcu08dXoZkHLs_K3mbmtKmjYvzSO5_3jj64LHRojzJcpq7OEU8Ajh7g5Jgonq-ZaHhr5ZRlUn1zGPueGsqAP3mXtf-8MBLVZB6iE15ytldDgyVGE0_IMTUaHAR3x-zxbNGOt80yIXbNs0T2Vvfc44-VAvkkQ9O68nY3pqtNeA8Uo3-5j0_sJXWHzdKr5TghWEV6FF3lHkkAv-ExWVExy2bTh7T7Cpf4OrNysFD02YMIbt8B)

clean_body: I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life. | Fellow American, The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, The path we're on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW. We MUST act, and we must do so today. Thank you for all you do, and God bless. name: Matt Gaetz
subject: This is what winning looks like
body:
We shook up Washington D.C.

| | [ ](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=638467894c1c45448bcc35f9a758ccd6&_e=s_FT5j8rLyLRdcg8aDnC-BfzVKxWKXXwOna9ehTz3k45mxDkJkJE12hSCtbhdsS3Q-TKNQPQYL1eNOJmyT4cRJ5_X_DjrWaU7uCuo7zbUoesCdmUVFKGAJUcN7C_sI-KMh-wzszXwOF7--gAeLrOpe4Ug7ixjv9djHVCcn2m4G9v6mnMjj9ZYS9TIR3I2yEpP0yBuBrQ2O6nfkaGdjBVuMIhksEBbV5pgCxX5gMQlVxr-Luo7JMrB_DkhC5YW7zGlbovWQbZVvk88B7PxeM12gcchH_mD5zhLZpKyWmWISc%3D)
---
Friend, this is what it's all about. **Congressman Mike Johnson is our new Speaker of the House!**
| [ ](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=638467894c1c45448bcc35f9a758ccd6&_e=s_FT5j8rLyLRdcg8aDnC-BfzVKxWKXXwOna9ehTz3k45mxDkJkJE12hSCtbhdsS3Q-TKNQPQYL1eNOJmyT4cRJ5_X_DjrWaU7uCuo7zbUoesCdmUVFKGAJUcN7C_sI-KMh-wzszXwOF7--gAeLrOpfiwDAHOCg8VgMkDoPwQcg4zNhcAeFG9VspYMfdIBTHSlO9CY_Z9DEGhggCpi4bu4h_FqWVZyim1A57cvjLvy4_yD854HUuhm2awqJOue0BLDBFThiXMke2eITOr1JBfcaBvBIpLSdmBRjUNoGeCNf0%3D)
---
**We dealt the Swamp a MAJOR blow, and I can proudly say the American people WON.** This entire fight has shown those in Washington that they are NOT untouchable and we reminded them who they are supposed to be fighting for... you! Speaker Johnson is the champion Americans deserve as Speaker of the House. He is a leader in the fight to put America First and has been one of President Trump's biggest supporters. Speaker Johnson will support single-subject spending bills -- which is what our fight was all about -- **and he is the biggest threat to the Swamp and the lobbyists who have infected Capitol Hill for far too long. ** Friend, if you recall, those who benefit from the Swamps corruption tried to label me as an "arsonist" in Congress, and my name was ruthlessly dragged through the mud. They tried to claim that I created chaos in Washington by holding leadership accountable and rejecting their lobbyist-approved Continuing Resolution. And for that, they threatened to EXPEL me from Congress. And as they tried to make an example out of me for those who refuse to bend the knee, patriots like you thankfully stood by my side, and the only thing these Swamp creatures ended up doing was expose themselves to the world. To top it off, we managed to walk away with a decisive victory by putting the gavel into the hands of an Ultimate MAGA Republican. But while this is a historic victory for America, we can't pat ourselves on the back and count our chips. _**The real fight has just begun.**_ Now's the time to use this momentum to open the floodgates and Drain the Swamp once and for all. **[That 's why I need you to stand with me once again by chipping in your most generous contribution today so I can continue to lay the pressure on in Congress.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=638467894c1c45448bcc35f9a758ccd6&_e=s_FT5j8rLyLRdcg8aDnC-BfzVKxWKXXwOna9ehTz3k45mxDkJkJE12hSCtbhdsS3Q-TKNQPQYL1eNOJmyT4cRJ5_X_DjrWaU7uCuo7zbUoesCdmUVFKGAJUcN7C_sI-KMh-wzszXwOF7--gAeLrOpQJAWyKl-FbSfJqx7Bj8fWlndUr2QK8gsrL8rHe8TtXoBraTy8HoBpHYLPBq0-5BoHNVlGRWM5P8uOCkghoJKNQPM-TXzAc2hJks6CJTh_ukgWitVogGIhYksGTODe9c-jt7YW35AYhEDEWFrxToNQc%3D)**
| [ **KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING - CHIP IN TODAY** ](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=638467894c1c45448bcc35f9a758ccd6&_e=s_FT5j8rLyLRdcg8aDnC-BfzVKxWKXXwOna9ehTz3k45mxDkJkJE12hSCtbhdsS3Q-TKNQPQYL1eNOJmyT4cRJ5_X_DjrWaU7uCuo7zbUoesCdmUVFKGAJUcN7C_sI-KMh-wzszXwOF7--gAeLrOpd73nvgjdYNJHh3_EzQnmNJ3Iyde0XpptrnFzAOoQSvorItdnJ8cilWxdJbUZOb5XCCNFjRB5I2BB9fWV92r9POb3shClIzhs98z4LlxctkvxG5_tXAOErpdV6yew4IxLoERSg-UuV0ATLI9lSENQjU%3D)
---
**Friend, it 's victories like these that make all our efforts worthwhile.** I didn't come to Washington D.C. to make friends or to take the easy way out. And I will never give in to the lobbyist's pleas to get back to "business as usual." This is exactly why I'm the only member of Congress who doesn't take money from special interests or PACs as so many do. I rely on the support of those who I fight for. Folks like you. I need your help like never before. _**Will you stand with me to use this momentum to break this fever and rid Washington of the Swamp 's infection?**_ **[Join the fight to Drain the Swamp by chipping in $10, $20, $30, or more today.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=638467894c1c45448bcc35f9a758ccd6&_e=s_FT5j8rLyLRdcg8aDnC-BfzVKxWKXXwOna9ehTz3k45mxDkJkJE12hSCtbhdsS3Q-TKNQPQYL1eNOJmyT4cRJ5_X_DjrWaU7uCuo7zbUoesCdmUVFKGAJUcN7C_sI-KMh-wzszXwOF7--gAeLrOpcz5KpIzNDM5TgVipmZtcQDaWMGJichrUS7Eyt80KeI8RLN0UzMSFQX2LnRdKhuORlhB5GwN5qbtBW4LEp900nlnFqWL_CeOKUEl3qsJdfqygjKzvP38Lg2___rVxAjZl4yAmwxRxC3SMe-S_F5nVgA%3D)** Thanks for standing strong, Matt Gaetz

| **_October was a HUGE month for our campaign._** I’m proud to report that we _brought in a record number of individual donations_ —**more than 450 people** donated to our campaign so far this month. Together, [we can get that number even higher](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=98715a3983&e=fc26432468 "Original URL: https://secure.winred.com/drew-johnson-for-congress/victory-2024. Click or tap if you trust this link.").
I was honored to speak to the **Sun City Summerlin Conservative Club** and **UNLV College Republicans**. In addition, I also attended **Nevada Policy** ’s fantastic annual benefit dinner as well as a joint fundraiser for **Battle Born Republican Women****, the Republican Women of Las Vegas****, and Southern Hills Republican Women.**
Finally, I spent time with a number of Republican members of Congress just as they were selecting a new House speaker. I am proud to report that they made a great choice. **_Mike Johnson is a principled, unifying voice who will prove to be a great speaker._** I look forward to working with him after I’m elected to represent Nevada’s 3rd congressional district!
But that doesn’t mean that it’s all good news. In fact, there are several things going on with our government that are downright frightful. So, I thought I’d use Halloween as an opportunity to share a list of the **"Government's Top-5 Spookiest Tricks"** that will be haunting Southern Nevada residents this Halloween.
---
|
# _Government's Top-5 Spookiest Tricks_ :
1. **INFLATION**
Here in Las Vegas, the cost of Halloween candy, decorations, and costumes is up more than 13% over last year. That means **_the average household will spend nearly $15 more than last Halloween_** , with nothing more to show for it, all because of the blood-sucking inflationary policies of big-spenders like Joe Biden and Susie Lee.
2. **WASTEFUL SPENDING**
The National Institutes of Health gave **_$418,000 of OUR tax money_** to researchers at the University of Maryland to **_develop underwear with electronics_** to measure how the sound and smell of flatulence changes depending on what people eat.
3. **REPUBLICANS WE CAN’T TRUST**
Heidi Kasama, my GOP primary challenger in Nevada’s 3rd congressional district, has a terrible habit of stabbing Republicans in the back. First, **_Kasama oversaw $35,000 in campaign donations to Democratic Hamas sympathizers Rashida Tlaib and Ilhan Omar_**. Then, as a member of the Nevada Assembly, **_Heidi voted to send $25 million in state taxpayers’ money to the Culinary Union_** , a far-left organization that campaigns each cycle to defeat Republicans up and down the ballot.
4. **FOREIGN AID**
Under President Biden, the United States has sent more than $730 million to the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees. **_That money has been used to fund, among other things, teachers and educational materials calling for the murder of Jews._** Some of the funds have also reportedly fallen into the hands of anti-US and anti-Israeli terrorist organizations.
5. **TERRIBLE TARIFFS**
Biden’s Commerce Department is considering a plan to levy expensive tariffs on the type of metal used to make tin cans. As I mentioned in [a column I wrote](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8937d2b928&e=fc26432468) for the Reno Gazette Journal, **this cruel and regressive tax would _hammer lower-income Nevadans by increasing the cost of pantry staples _**from canned corn and Spam to Campbell’s soup and dog food by about 58 cents per can.

As a government watchdog and conservative policy analyst, you can _trust me to make government smaller and a little less spooky_.

**Please join our fight by following me on social media **– and if you see something you like, please don’t forget to like and share it!

# _**On the Campaign Trail**_
Drew was the guest speaker at the October meeting of the **Sun City Summerlin Conservatives Club.** He discussed his journey from growing up poor in rural Appalachia to becoming a national conservative columnist and one of America's leading taxpayer watchdogs.
---
|
---
---
| Drew joined conservative commentator **Katie Pavlich** and more than a dozen members of Congress at **a fundraiser for United Zatzalah in Washington, DC.** United Hatzalah is an independent, non-profit, fully volunteer emergency medical service organization that provides life-saving emergency medical services throughout Israel free of charge and often in less than two minutes.
---

---
| Drew attended **Nevada Policy's "Spirit of Las Vegas" benefit dinner** featuring Victor David Hanson. Drew is a huge fan of Nevada Policy, as well as the founder and longtime president of Nevada Policy's sister think tank in Tennessee, where his work led to lower taxes, increased parental choice, and fewer regulatory burdens on job creators.

| _**Taxpayer Pledge**_
Earlier this month, Drew signed the Federal Taxpayer Protection Pledge, which is his promise to the taxpayers of Nevada that he will:

1\. Oppose any and all efforts to increase marginal income tax rates for individuals and businesses.

2\. Oppose any net reduction or elimination of deductions and credits, unless matched dollar for dollar, by further reducing tax rates.

A former fellow of the Taxpayers Protection Alliance and policy analyst at the National Taxpayers Union, Drew has saved taxpayers over $60 billion in his career. He is dedicated to saving Nevadans from burdensome tax increases.

Want to help Drew? This race is going to be tight and having the help of supporters like you is the only way we can win!

body:
NeverAgainCA Announces Its Support for Gun Safety Champion, Senator Min | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/71d2007e29e6/gun-violence-prevention-advocates-endorse-dave-min-for-congress-15664508?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** October 30, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com) **Gun Violence Prevention Advocates
Endorse Dave Min for Congress**
_NeverAgainCA Announces Its Support for
Gun Safety Champion, Senator Min _ **IRVINE, CA —** Today, NeverAgainCA announced its endorsement of Dave Min for Congress, citing Min’s strong legislative record on gun violence in the California State Senate. Senator Min worked closely with NeverAgainCA on his [2021 bill](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=8428aba80c&e=7017cc100e) to end gun shows at the Orange County fairgrounds and on his subsequent [2022 bill](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=26a6ae84f4&e=7017cc100e) which expanded the scope of the ban to all public property in the state. This is the first endorsement from a major gun violence prevention group in the race, and comes on the heels of [last week’s overwhelming vote for the California Democratic Party’s endorsement for Senator Min](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=15ca10c565&e=7017cc100e).

**"When it comes to ending gun violence, Dave Min has been our champion for years--not only with his words but with his actions. Senator Min doesn’t make promises he doesn’t intend to keep,”** said Rose Ann Sharp, founder of NeverAgain CA. **“He told us he would work to end the sale of firearms, ammunition and ghost guns at the Orange County Fairground. In his first year in the CA Senate, he did just that. In his second year, he took action to protect all Californians and passed legislation banning the sale of firearms, ammunition and ghost guns on all California fairgrounds and state-owned properties. He has continued to push for a myriad of thoughtful gun violence prevention legislation since that time. Dave is a remarkably effective legislator, and a man of integrity who does what he says he’ll do. Never Again CA is excited to continue our partnership with Dave Min when he is elected to represent CA-47 in Congress."**

NeverAgain formed in the aftermath of 2018’s Parkland shooting. Their members and activists have been an essential voice in the gun violence prevention space, and regularly appear at protests, town halls, city council meetings, and at the state house.

As a father to school-aged children, Min has made gun violence prevention a major focus of his tenure in the State Senate, and plans to continue prioritizing the issue in US Congress. He has authored a number of other key gun violence prevention bills in the State Senate, and has consistently earned an ‘F’ rating from the National Rifle Association.

After impressive fundraising hauls in the first three quarters of this year, Dave Min has consolidated support behind him as he has become the clear Democratic consensus candidate to succeed Katie Porter. In addition to the Democratic Party’s endorsement, he is also supported by Congresswoman Porter and a broad and diverse coalition of over 150 local, state, and federal leaders. He enjoys broad grassroots support, with over 1000 volunteers signed up to knock on doors for his campaign (many of whom have volunteered with Min’s prior campaigns), and is the candidate of Labor, with the official endorsement of the AFL-CIO’s Orange County Labor Federation, and early endorsements from Teachers, School Employees, Police Officers, SEIU, and many others. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=14d67ca38a&e=7017cc100e).
_###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

We’re in this race for the long haul. But it’s going to be tough. With all the chaos in Washington (especially now), Montanans deserve someone who will crack down on the special interests and corruption in Washington, not play political games and cut backroom deals. We need to fight to lower costs for hardworking families, create good-paying union jobs, and ensure rural communities have what they need, like reliable internet and hospitals within driving distance.

Peter, I’m not a career politician. I’m pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. **I still farm the same land my grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago, and I try every day to do what’s right for the people of Montana and across the country.**

Because of that, I don’t have much patience for the fancy billionaires and shady super PACs a lot of other politicians rely on. Instead, I depend on grassroots supporters like you.

This might be your only warning.

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd6s8csi5h4pcvtotfes5m256q8aspb7nj8flf68_rp22sh2s8i66p70stg68ob4clh2bs). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3uetjceahcamgqtg4umcb9qt581peltdh1o621o_rp22sh2s8i66p70stg68ob4clh2bs) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. name: Mike Johnson
subject: Let me introduce myself
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
|
[ ](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/e6OaOFjF_s2PE_FiAVDXaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnIqgoP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMDMwJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplPV3sP2WMOWLKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/e6OaOFjF_s2PE_FiAVDXaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnIqgoP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMDMwJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplPV3sP2WMOWLKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/e6OaOFjF_s2PE_FiAVDXaQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnIqgoP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMDMwJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplPV3sP2WMOWLKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. The Bay Area is a special place to me.
For those who don’t know this, I grew up here. My family has lived here for 95 years, in all corners of the Bay, and I’ve always felt that I have a duty to fulfill in this community.

Well, next year, I have the chance to do just that. You see, folks, if I’m elected to represent California’s 12th district, I’ll be the first Latino elected to Congress from the Bay Area!
It’s never been done before. Despite the huge Latino population in the Bay Area and the generations of us who have lived here, I would be the first elected to Congress. To me, this means everything.
Representation matters – and I wholeheartedly believe that it’s essential to have folks in power who not only have life experiences like ours but also who fight for us.
So folks, can I count on you to chip in today and support my vision to represent our diverse community and fight for our shared values? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/timsanchez?refcode=X_103023_first]
Thank you,
Tim

The absence of a Speaker isn't just a procedural issue; it reflects the deep divisions and challenges our legislative body faces. These moments remind us why local actions, like ballot measures, are vital to ensuring the needs of citizens aren't lost amidst the political wrangling in Washington. In these turbulent times, when partisan divides have often brought meaningful legislation to a standstill, ballot measures have become a beacon of light for direct democracy. **When Congress can't act, ballot measures allow voters to reclaim their power. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---

I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: | | | | | | Hi Friend, Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you. Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my SECOND debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter! I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " ** | | - | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.
