body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a17de9eabea445e893459b77b9d01d8b&_e=R-x8BJA8C8sAnjUG6cTGYT5h2UyTe1E2XbaP_Csxr00aksX4nR-JRp06Fd5xzghRkneiAUkE6I_ZJrC_ac2GN9kid2P_06j86PnaF0QEc_2odJ3RuVqi1cqanvRNhZebDtJUuA3mBJ0rDnEJyazkfvpFMdB57YS9TqCAiuW7Z0ioXEVnjDoCdwhwcVnyXIVlKzKTNtuUqmNE6eBofKog6RGETQtqGJle7RByeGPqG2BapKdlRtSNtwA7Q16318R4vimlvBh_WPrQH90pTR-iQ7DS8hQsQTlj8M8suiYeAQlvzqRmQiO-ZpszpJfd8OQobDW8q1ALUa1S0YyR_M4OR3LLyMzDPmX7xgmBA532w4GYYO7TI1dziQ_Xf7Z57eXP)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a17de9eabea445e893459b77b9d01d8b&_e=R-x8BJA8C8sAnjUG6cTGYT5h2UyTe1E2XbaP_Csxr00aksX4nR-JRp06Fd5xzghRkneiAUkE6I_ZJrC_ac2GN9kid2P_06j86PnaF0QEc_2odJ3RuVqi1cqanvRNhZebDtJUuA3mBJ0rDnEJyazkfvpFMdB57YS9TqCAiuW7Z0ioXEVnjDoCdwhwcVnyXIVlKzKTNtuUqmNE6eBofKog6RGETQtqGJle7RByeGPqG2CR_RQ7DXfjK_irXnXJvOE2K_eKCvNduxSvnYvFZgButD3i02Y53TBi4SES0V7hdWmuLJl1bSNSP8JNuS3xT2L_bI9niWmyCUFNFpkhG8MovRYXry7bCU4BoWfUANP1yz9XzdzGay2b69OQ9popVQ9R) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a17de9eabea445e893459b77b9d01d8b&_e=R-x8BJA8C8sAnjUG6cTGYT5h2UyTe1E2XbaP_Csxr00aksX4nR-JRp06Fd5xzghRkneiAUkE6I_ZJrC_ac2GN9kid2P_06j86PnaF0QEc_2odJ3RuVqi1cqanvRNhZebDtJUuA3mBJ0rDnEJyazkfvpFMdB57YS9TqCAiuW7Z0ioXEVnjDoCdwhwcVnyXIVlKzKTNtuUqmNE6eBofKog6RGETQtqGJle7RByeGPqG2BCrEhSlbWylH3Rp8RK1p_wFSZKZwGEWlVW5_nH3lahQjTQgOQzCqgdKLTFswbJ70PQThICGwe90Lx98kIVmAUgUNG7GgDTmBSNMM4j6AR3mA1jrq55NvuM_q9XkBZGi19arVuXuL8aD4nFzR8ZWpw4)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. Peter, Watching the speakership crisis unfold, we were reminded of Obi-Wan Kenobi's wisdom in Revenge of the Sith (bear with us as we walk through this metaphor):
# Only a Sith deals in absolutes.
The whole point of American democracy is that we work together – that our elected leaders find common ground to advance the common good. But in order to become Speaker, **Rep. Mike Johnson all but forswore any attempts at bipartisanship or compromise.** Why? He needed to appease extremists. **If we want things to change in D.C., we need to start electing leaders who are more interested in solving problems than caving to the extremists in their own party.** Like the Jedi code instructs, a good Representative should strive to "serve others rather than ruling over them." body:
It's been an eventful week, and I'm thrilled to recap the highlights of the past few days with you!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

It's been an eventful week, and I'm thrilled to recap the highlights of the past few days with you. Alongside exciting campaign events like the Jennings County Lincoln Day Dinner, the Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner, and engaging with the Allen County Republican Women's Club, I'm delighted to share two new articles that provide a deeper look into my life (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ap_iaemxtodh7&fbclid=IwAR1C9I9BJVJ69pOgpGyvq7wf2oyDXh4d5wq6iIMYM4TifgyqbV27idx9iHs&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and my plan (https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as your Governor.

Read on for last week's highlights!

** Volunteer Callout! Join us on Election Day
------------------------------------------------------------

To sign up as a volunteer or to learn more about our Election Day efforts, please reach out to our volunteer coordinator at jp@crouchforindiana.com (mailto:jp@crouchforindiana.com?subject=Election%20Day%20Volunteer%20Callout) .

** In the News: Crouch 'reimagines' government, taxes (https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

As your Governor, I plan to reimagine government, ensuring it works for you. By streamlining agencies and connecting services, we'll create a government that's more accessible and responsive to your needs.

Thank you to Brian Howey for sitting down with me to discuss how I plan to lead Indiana forward.
https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Read The Article (https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** In the News: O (https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ut Of Darkness (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ap_iaemxtodh7&fbclid=IwAR1C9I9BJVJ69pOgpGyvq7wf2oyDXh4d5wq6iIMYM4TifgyqbV27idx9iHs&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

I'm committed to expanding Indiana's mental health services because, for me and countless others, it's deeply personal. We must provide help - it's a cause we can't afford to ignore.

My heartfelt thanks to Mary Milz and Indianapolis Monthly (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ap_iaemxtodh7&fbclid=IwAR1C9I9BJVJ69pOgpGyvq7wf2oyDXh4d5wq6iIMYM4TifgyqbV27idx9iHs&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for sharing my story.
https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ap_iaemxtodh7&fbclid=IwAR1C9I9BJVJ69pOgpGyvq7wf2oyDXh4d5wq6iIMYM4TifgyqbV27idx9iHs&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Read The Article (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=ap_iaemxtodh7&fbclid=IwAR1C9I9BJVJ69pOgpGyvq7wf2oyDXh4d5wq6iIMYM4TifgyqbV27idx9iHs&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Jennings County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the immense privilege of addressing a vibrant crowd of over 200 attendees at the Jennings County Lincoln-Reagan Dinner. It was a fantastic event, and I'm deeply grateful to Jennings County Party Chair Brian Hatfield and Vice Chair Mandy Creech for their warm welcome.

Let's continue the tradition of strong Republican leadership in Jennings County!

** Allen County Republican Women's Club
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I spent an inspiring afternoon with the incredible women of the Allen County Republican Women's Club.

It was truly an honor to engage in meaningful discussions with these outstanding ladies, and I'm proud to stand beside them as we work together toward a brighter future for Indiana.

** Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner:
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the privilege of listening to National GOP Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel at the Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner and was equally honored to take the stage to share my vision for Indiana.

As we approach this critical election, our party is more united, enthusiastic, and stronger than ever.

** Witnessing the Blue Angels in Action
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

In between campaign stops, I had the chance to witness the awe-inspiring practice of the Blue Angels as they prepared for the weekend Crossroads Classic.

It's a testament to the talent, dedication, and precision of our nation's military that fills us all with pride and gratitude.

** Adams County Benjamin Harrison Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Started Saturday on a high note at the Adams County Republican Party's Benjamin Harrison Breakfast!

It was an honor to keynote this event and share the stage with our incredible emcee, Pat Miller from 1190 WOWO.

** Shoutout to Team Crouch!
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I can't help but express my admiration for the incredible support of Team Crouch. A special shoutout goes to Former Rep. Woody Burton and his wife Volly, who turned heads and won hearts at the Greenwood parade by dressing in delightful Halloween costumes. Thank you, thank you very much, for your unwavering support! 🌟

** Last Week's Endorsements
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

“I am supporting Suzanne Crouch for Governor because she has experience at all levels of government in Indiana. From my experience as a former legislator, I know how valuable it is to understand how actions will affect Hoosiers across the state. Suzanne has proven she is dedicated to the people of Indiana by her service. She is enthusiastic about the future of Indiana and has the ability to lead us forward as our Governor.”

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f9077cef8f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_27_07_16&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f9077cef8f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

“Suzanne Crouch is uniquely qualified to be our next Governor of Indiana. In her past, she has been a Republican county chair, an elected official in county government, a state representative, the state auditor, and is currently the Indiana lieutenant governor. The vast experience Suzanne has received must be considered when choosing the most qualified candidate to be our next Indiana Governor. I support Suzanne Crouch for our next Governor of Indiana.”

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

It's moments like these that make me grateful for the fantastic team and supporters we have by our side, dedicated to building a better, stronger Indiana.

As we continue on the campaign trail, your enthusiasm and commitment keep me motivated and focused. Let's keep working hard, shoulder to shoulder, to make Indiana the best it can be.

clean_body: It's been an eventful week, and I'm thrilled to recap the highlights of the past few days with you! Friends and fellow Hoosiers, It's been an eventful week, and I'm thrilled to recap the highlights of the past few days with you. Alongside exciting campaign events like the Jennings County Lincoln Day Dinner, the Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner, and engaging with the Allen County Republican Women's Club, I'm delighted to share two new articles that provide a deeper look into my life () and my plan () as your Governor. Read on for last week's highlights! Volunteer Callout! Join us on Election Day To sign up as a volunteer or to learn more about our Election Day efforts, please reach out to our volunteer coordinator at jp@crouchforindiana.com (mailto:jp@crouchforindiana.com?subject=Election%20Day%20Volunteer%20Callout) . In the News: Crouch 'reimagines' government, taxes () As your Governor, I plan to reimagine government, ensuring it works for you. By streamlining agencies and connecting services, we'll create a government that's more accessible and responsive to your needs. Thank you to Brian Howey for sitting down with me to discuss how I plan to lead Indiana forward. Read The Article () In the News: O () ut Of Darkness () I'm committed to expanding Indiana's mental health services because, for me and countless others, it's deeply personal. We must provide help - it's a cause we can't afford to ignore. My heartfelt thanks to Mary Milz and Indianapolis Monthly () for sharing my story. Read The Article () Jennings County Lincoln Day Dinner I had the immense privilege of addressing a vibrant crowd of over 200 attendees at the Jennings County Lincoln-Reagan Dinner. It was a fantastic event, and I'm deeply grateful to Jennings County Party Chair Brian Hatfield and Vice Chair Mandy Creech for their warm welcome. Let's continue the tradition of strong Republican leadership in Jennings County! Allen County Republican Women's Club I spent an inspiring afternoon with the incredible women of the Allen County Republican Women's Club. It was truly an honor to engage in meaningful discussions with these outstanding ladies, and I'm proud to stand beside them as we work together toward a brighter future for Indiana. Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner: I had the privilege of listening to National GOP Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel at the Allen County Reagan Bean Dinner and was equally honored to take the stage to share my vision for Indiana. As we approach this critical election, our party is more united, enthusiastic, and stronger than ever. Witnessing the Blue Angels in Action In between campaign stops, I had the chance to witness the awe-inspiring practice of the Blue Angels as they prepared for the weekend Crossroads Classic. It's a testament to the talent, dedication, and precision of our nation's military that fills us all with pride and gratitude. Adams County Benjamin Harrison Breakfast Started Saturday on a high note at the Adams County Republican Party's Benjamin Harrison Breakfast! It was an honor to keynote this event and share the stage with our incredible emcee, Pat Miller from 1190 WOWO. Shoutout to Team Crouch! I can't help but express my admiration for the incredible support of Team Crouch. A special shoutout goes to Former Rep. Woody Burton and his wife Volly, who turned heads and won hearts at the Greenwood parade by dressing in delightful Halloween costumes. Thank you, thank you very much, for your unwavering support! 🌟 Last Week's Endorsements “I am supporting Suzanne Crouch for Governor because she has experience at all levels of government in Indiana. From my experience as a former legislator, I know how valuable it is to understand how actions will affect Hoosiers across the state. Suzanne has proven she is dedicated to the people of Indiana by her service. She is enthusiastic about the future of Indiana and has the ability to lead us forward as our Governor.” “Suzanne Crouch is uniquely qualified to be our next Governor of Indiana. In her past, she has been a Republican county chair, an elected official in county government, a state representative, the state auditor, and is currently the Indiana lieutenant governor. The vast experience Suzanne has received must be considered when choosing the most qualified candidate to be our next Indiana Governor. I support Suzanne Crouch for our next Governor of Indiana.” Last but not least... It's moments like these that make me grateful for the fantastic team and supporters we have by our side, dedicated to building a better, stronger Indiana. Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=62ca801427734fe7ae72b96b14bc1590&_e=Aa5KCXyV6z3FpbB2aQXWblDWiC72Zgb5oTpobpFlFpeioqg4YcE5_No3X1Yy_RBtWPoJqELhy35BNh8Is_FIGkvLSKj1cDZexdxNxbcvf6vHxyD6YQfB2S_iUC1swwIdyX3MByXu50wuaGydcmYB82_vj41dv0Q4LglHXXaSuMf1QnKysZ9AICj-podVkQUYgW7iMuluw7unvOhzeDwt81bqKR9Fxryw6Jr-4kgm9MBD8KAhHKUOBdwegL08tVTeYijz2QdIMzZrKF1A_FI13sh_2AZOpHO4GFHBrIhm2Q9G3UmZ1asclunYpyGTafDk6e5m0zafA5Zwn0GESAdUxcZY9shkwq6nmzJ9_OAAVj9skexhSW-Xbxr3-jqx6HnXpaoGRT12u1MWJN0OtZbAWyYsi36GEKVAqykvxVkYy_DLUMNFGWqsPSaTfk8MefXTZaiDXNgA9z4VxjffIcTCqo1Gj_8lJPfWLliIzHXd8iZpSenmGKJNu7vk9Mf5QAknTRS1SM5Sm00K7E_VLc4Agg8JpzdjQJKGRY_TM_EwBpvZrvsxuHNJL55sZKEZEPPXknL5FTKjQ6AQGId7CZ7N3YbHRDX5b4eCy6QisDOFY9xehzIRB4Rz0hCRmI2m_3Ue "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=62ca801427734fe7ae72b96b14bc1590&_e=Aa5KCXyV6z3FpbB2aQXWblDWiC72Zgb5oTpobpFlFpeioqg4YcE5_No3X1Yy_RBtWPoJqELhy35BNh8Is_FIGkvLSKj1cDZexdxNxbcvf6vHxyD6YQfB2S_iUC1swwIdyX3MByXu50wuaGydcmYB82_vj41dv0Q4LglHXXaSuMf1QnKysZ9AICj-podVkQUYgW7iMuluw7unvOhzeDwt81bqKR9Fxryw6Jr-4kgm9MBD8KAhHKUOBdwegL08tVTeYijz2QdIMzZrKF1A_FI13sh_2AZOpHO4GFHBrIhm2Q9G3UmZ1asclunYpyGTafDk6e5m0zafA5Zwn0GESAdUxcZY9shkwq6nmzJ9_OAAVj9skexhSW-Xbxr3-jqx6HnXpaoGRT12u1MWJN0OtZbAWyYsi36GEKVAqykvxVkYy_DLUMNFGWqsPSaTfk8MefXTZaiDXNgA9z4VxjffIcTCqo1Gj_8lJPfWLliIzHXd8ibfQvzMmW_U4iUpkpdts8Wbb7QiyM0VjU4UliitIxvWAALIUjFIRxmfa3T2Y-QEY0nr4W99kOnbrPkqKsTyKNcmZdDbm5gubFFB33tG4IFoiUqJPoFrLmNzG__zyKdPTvSZQNCKGUeBN9J7Jwbwu8O0)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=62ca801427734fe7ae72b96b14bc1590&_e=Aa5KCXyV6z3FpbB2aQXWblDWiC72Zgb5oTpobpFlFpeioqg4YcE5_No3X1Yy_RBtWPoJqELhy35BNh8Is_FIGkvLSKj1cDZexdxNxbcvf6vHxyD6YQfB2S_iUC1swwIdyX3MByXu50wuaGydcmYB82_vj41dv0Q4LglHXXaSuMf1QnKysZ9AICj-podVkQUYgW7iMuluw7unvOhzeDwt81bqKR9Fxryw6Jr-4kgm9MBD8KAhHKUOBdwegL08tVTeYijz2QdIMzZrKF1A_FI13sh_2AZOpHO4GFHBrIhm2Q9G3UmZ1asclunYpyGTafDk6e5m0zafA5Zwn0GESAdUxcZY9shkwq6nmzJ9_OAAVj9skexhSW-Xbxr3-jqx6HnXpaoGRT12u1MWJN0OtZbAWyYsi36GEKVAqykvxVkYy_DLUMNFGWqsPSaTfk8MefXTZaiDXNgA9z4VxjffIcTCqo1Gj_8lJPfWLliIzHXd8iZlC41LSlZkUkHjT7-xCgzu8YeNCcb0_QNDD5Zh6fyevrl9LIeeHRRDEWC4gAmAPfGEcKFfHqPLU1kz_YagkTbfv2qzBhbfBJxAFKJ-Pi-agQ7jLEuDMN4-K3WXGtoprGio4pPVV3VoqKtdo5StseAD)

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my SECOND debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter! I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " ** | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. name: John Kasich
subject: A better way to move forward
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any
body:
The best news that came out of this process was that the House immediately moved to pass a resolution affirming America's support for Israel.| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=eea83f91b6304e68b707379f71c3b8be&_e=63pYj1pn83ZLOLWH7BctuaM3J4ZE1TG4q4Tyl45-ER4LZ5ESpQxLElc3cQYOyB4PeBlQnTdSinMelgdNbQw9EaDNMxBWQDAAHahLhvrflH7glkT2W6QoNfrZz4k8sVA_N2GXEdM0FRwXFIY1caRhQRfpkEgNM1VvO64lbT6jrTkwlA7Nqqgy9e7ZfkeW0z7-74boWBhmqJ3RfbdtzVHAXQ%3D%3D)
---
Peter, While I breathed a sigh of relief when the U.S. House of Representatives finally accomplished its most basic responsibility - organizing itself to pass legislation - I'm disappointed because I feel that there was a better way to move our country forward. The best news that came out of this process was that the House immediately moved to pass a resolution affirming America's support for Israel.
You've heard me say it before, but the only path forward that will result in bringing people together and getting big policy wins is if we marginalize the extreme wings of both parties and find common ground.

The American people are sick of the partisan politics. We've been stuck in this cycle where one party gets power, they pass highly partisan legislation without any buy-in or support from moderate members of the other party, and then things whip back suddenly when the other party takes control since they campaigned promising to undo everything the other folks did.

This is not a sustainable model and it's the reason why Congress can't even get basic things done like passing a budget or funding our vital government programs. We're not even having conversations about how to reduce spending or find more efficient ways to run the government because both parties are only listening to the people on the extremes that equate compromise with losing.

We need more of our elected officials to have courage and stand up, instead of putting their political future first. When I was in Congress, I witnessed many members willing to risk their careers to do the right thing. We need more of that today.

While in Congress, I worked with Democrat Congressman Tim Penny to create the Kasich-Penny plan that would reduce one penny of every dollar of government spending. We were trying to show that there was a way to find reasonable compromise for the American people. While our bill didn't pass, it received bipartisan support and started the conversation that led to the first balanced federal budget in nearly forty years!

We have to get over this sickness where our leaders act as if compromising on something to help Americans is a bad thing or considered losing. Where in life don't we have to compromise on things?

I'm hopeful that what we'll see next is a broad bipartisan effort to support our allies in Israel and Ukraine with the money and supplies that they need to defend their democracies. While those who don't know history or understand international relations may not understand, they should trust the experts who know that both of these are vital to America's national and economic security.

The world is watching - our allies are very concerned and our opponents are emboldened. Nobody is more happy about America's divisions than Russia's Putin. A weakened and divided America creates opportunities for evil people to fill the vacuum and expand their power.

I am worried for the future of America, but I remain hopeful that the fever will break and we will once again discover the potential of what America can become if we start working together again.
---
I'm out there every week giving speeches, doing media interviews, communicating on social media and using every other tool at my disposal to give hope and encouragement to as many Americans as I can.

[Peter - I'm counting on your continued support to ensure that we can keep this important work moving forward](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=eea83f91b6304e68b707379f71c3b8be&_e=63pYj1pn83ZLOLWH7BctuQ8k_QEwZCWhlw4MrZmwg-YQbLMP_dkBbnrEx7Nckg-a_hPGg28zFnUm9Ys1fWgNVaxlF-TIxzcQml9e8uxGYnjzD0090t-nfVyIJQX3hHqIb0OQ9TT9FETxXIThKt6GDYjTwDsoHt3uorT_S2Wi6n6EMo_ORIRBvX2m_md06qpj3Dcd8NL05hTNeyITt5St1x9N9PXev7jZDL6Li7cvweY%3D).

Will you please consider chipping in right now to help with this important cause and ensure that we can keep up the fight for a better America?

We did a little digging about Mike Johnson. And it turns out he’s everything you might expect — and worse. | | | Peter, Last week, after three weeks of infighting, House Republicans finally elected a Speaker of the House they could all agree on: Rep. Mike Johnson (R-LA). Never heard of him? We hadn’t really either. So we did a little digging. And it turns out he’s everything you might expect — and worse. **Every single Republican member of Congress voted to embrace an election denier, anti-abortion fanatic, anti-LGBTQ+ bigot, and all-around Trump enabler and MAGA extremist as their new leader.** But he’s also one of the least-well known people ever to be elevated to Speaker of the House. **[We know we can’t rely on the media to educate voters — it’s going to be up to us to make sure voters know exactly what they’re getting if they vote for Republican candidates for Congress next year. clean_body: We did a little digging about Mike Johnson. And it turns out he’s everything you might expect — and worse. | | | Peter, Last week, after three weeks of infighting, House Republicans finally elected a Speaker of the House they could all agree on: Rep. Mike Johnson (R-LA). Never heard of him? We hadn’t really either. So we did a little digging. And it turns out he’s everything you might expect — and worse. Every single Republican member of Congress voted to embrace an election denier, anti-abortion fanatic, anti-LGBTQ+ bigot, and all-around Trump enabler and MAGA extremist as their new leader. But he’s also one of the least-well known people ever to be elevated to Speaker of the House. Here are just some of the things we’ve learned about Mike Johnson over the last week: He referred to abortion as a “holocaust” and "linked the judicial philosophy that legalized the right to an abortion to Hitler." He played a central role in efforts to help Trump overturn the will of the voters leading up to the January 6th insurrection. He claimed same-sex marriage would lead to people marrying their pets. He co-sponsored a nationwide abortion ban, and worked at the right-wing organization now leading the charge to ban Mifepristone. He wanted to sentence abortion providers to “hard labor” after Roe v. Wade was overturned. He’s blamed school shootings on abortion. He’s also blamed school shootings on the teaching of evolution. He’s repeatedly given voice to far-right conspiracy theories like the “great replacement” theory. He’s championed “don’t say gay” bills. He’s called LGBTQ+ people “sinful” and “destructive.” And just last week he responded to the latest mass shooting in Maine by saying the problem isn’t guns, it’s “the human heart.” That’s just the beginning of what we are learning about someone who has been called “the least vetted Speaker in modern history.” And you can rest assured we’re going to learn a whole lot more before Election Day 2024. We aren’t about to let incumbent Republican members of Congress in key districts avoid accountability for empowering an anti-democracy, anti-abortion extremist. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? body:
| Friends,

After weeks of chaos, Ken Calvert and 219 other House Republicans voted to elect one of the most extreme Speakers in United States history. Here’s how we got to this point: **FIRST:** fringe Republicans led by Rep. Matt Gaetz ousted Kevin McCarthy from his speakership position.

**THEN:** they tried to elect Jim Jordan, but even his MAGA agenda wasn’t extreme enough.

**NOW:** they’ve opted for one of the MOST extreme Speakers in history and just elected Rep. Mike Johnson. And when we say extreme, friends, we mean it. Rep. Johnson was one of the architects of the plot to overturn the 2020 election in Congress, wants doctors imprisoned for performing abortion services, and thinks that LGBTQ+ people should be purged from our neighborhoods.

**_This isn't your grandfather's Republican Party. The MAGA-extremist wing is officially in control._**

body:
Words escape me.
#
Derek,
Like many of you, I was disgusted to hear Donald Trump's former Chief of Staff confirm, on the record, some of the unthinkable things Trump said about our service members, Veterans, and fallen troops.
“Losers.”
“Suckers.”
That he was repulsed by the sight of our wounded heroes.
Words escape me.
Donald Trump has no idea of honor. He has no idea of patriotism.
My father was killed in Vietnam. He was shot down over a Ho Chi Minh trail section just outside of Vietnam in Laos. He delivered close air support to special forces on the ground, and his airplane blew up.
His dog tag was recovered at the crash site. This dog tag:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct23.zemByr&refcode=em231030-2-30-nor&t=1&akid=18254%2E3013755%2EeoVhs5)
My father was a patriot. Well-educated. He was not a sucker. He was not a loser.
The best men and women of the United States are found in our military. Brave men and women, They are not just brave, they are smart. They are wise.
And I will tell you this. My anger, two years after reading about Trump's words — words confirmed yesterday by his former Chief of Staff — has not subsided.
And I am committed, once again, to do everything I can to ensure he never steps foot inside the White House again. So please:

With all of the chaos in Washington, including continued threats to our most basic human rights, we need a strong, experienced People’s Lawyer laser-focused on improving the lives of Pennsylvanians. **Here’s how we do it:**
* **Life is expensive.** I’ll protect the paychecks of hard working families and hold accountable anyone who illegally and discriminatorily prevents people from pursuing opportunities for advancement.
* **Businesses deserve to make their own good business decisions.** I’ll protect diversity, equity and inclusion practices that ensure everyone has an equal opportunity to advance in the workplace.
* **Our education system is failing our children.** I’ll make sure the law protects every child equally, including how we invest in their futures across the commonwealth.
* **Our streets are flooded with illegal guns.** I will enforce common sense gun laws and hold accountable those who play a role in the illegal and negligent distribution of guns.
* **We’re dealing with multiple physical and mental health crises.** I’ll be an attorney general who protects your RIGHT to healthcare.

Friend, Next Tuesday, Ohio voters will decide whether basic access to abortion is a protected right. So much hinges on winning this vote—and we’re doing everything we can to turn out every pro-choice voter to run up the margins. body:
I’ve experienced the issues our country is facing through my patients’ eyes, through the lives of my fellow servicemembers, and as a father and husband. | | One morning while eating breakfast before school, my middle school daughter asked, **"Do you like running for Congress?"** It caught me off guard because usually, _I’m_ the one asking her questions about what she likes. Without hesitation, I said, “Yes, I do,” which led to a longer discussion over waffles soaked in syrup about the demands of being a candidate, and how campaigning impacts our family. And I felt a sense of pride seeing how my desire to serve is shaping my daughter’s worldview, as my father’s service did mine.

As a boy, I watched with pride as my father put on his Air Force uniform day after day. Seeing his commitment to something greater than himself instilled a sense of service within me. A family legacy I continued as a first-generation college graduate, Air Force officer, and trauma surgeon. **Service before self is an ethos I internalized during my formative years at the United States Air Force Academy — and running for Congress is the best way for me to continue to serve.**

**I’ve seen the issues our country is facing through my patients’ eyes, through the lives of my fellow servicemembers, and as a father and husband.** Gun violence, affordable healthcare, reproductive freedom, and the climate crisis are all issues we must address immediately – and I am ready to bring my record of service as a veteran, doctor, and community leader to Washington and get the job done.

**So yes, Peter, I do like running for Congress.** Because I know we can solve the issues of today by sending the right leaders to serve. So I’m answering the call, but to win, I need your help. **[Tomorrow, my campaign will be facing its October end-of-month deadline, and my team set a goal to raise $50,000 before midnight. | Peter,

Today, I’m announcing my re-election campaign for NC’s 4th Congressional District.

My roots in this district run deep. I ran for office after years of service to my community – advocating for North Carolina families on the Chapel Hill-Carrboro Schools Board to the Orange County Board of Commissioners, to serving in the North Carolina state House and then state Senate.

In Congress, I’ve remained steadfast in my commitment to prevent gun violence, ensure access to abortion care, and take action to protect our planet from climate change. The urgency of these issues cannot be understated.
---
| | _“Congresswoman Foushee is a bold, progressive fighter for her constituents who has championed access to abortion, Medicare for All, the Green New Deal and many other progressive priorities. We need her continued leadership in the House and for the 4th District. We’re proud to endorse Congresswoman Foushee’s re-election to continue her work on behalf of the people of North Carolina’s 4th congressional district.”_

**Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC Co-Chairs Pramila Jayapal, Mark Pocan, and Jamie Raskin**
---
Tandem with these issues is the need to fortify our voting rights, fight against egregious partisan gerrymandering, and defend our democracy. The uncertainty of voting rights in the past year and even in the past month here in North Carolina confirms my job is far from over.

We’ve made incredible progress this year. I’m proud to have three critical voting rights bills in committee and to be a member of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force.

As the Republican party veers into far-right extremism, we must maintain a steady momentum on the issues that matter most.

**But in order to keep this momentum going strong, we need to hit our end-of-month goal:** [_So I’m asking you today, friend, if you would chip in $10 right now so we can prove to everyone that we have what it takes to flip NY-03 blue._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2310-eom?amount=10?source=em231030-zm-90do&refcode2=553_8507_RlKfFl&akid=553%2E8507%2ERlKfFl)

Donald Trump Jr. takes the stage in Addison on October 27, 2023. (Photo credit: Mark Vargas)
New York Times bestselling author Donald Trump Jr., son of the 45th President of the United States Donald J. Trump and the leading candidate in the Republican Primary for President visited Illinois on Friday where he spoke at the McHenry County GOPAC (https://www.dailyherald.com/news/20231027/trump-jr-talks-inflation-ukraine-war-to-base-voters-in-the-suburbs?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) event in Addison to talk presidential politics and to promote Letters to Trump as part of a 4-stop, one-day book tour.

Donald Trump Jr. was visiting Illinois in his capacity as co-founder of Winning Team Publishing and as an invited special guest to promote Letters To Trump – a bestselling book and only the second official one since President Donald Trump left office. The book is a fascinating and rare collection of letters from some of the world’s most recognizable names including Oprah Winfrey, President Richard Nixon, President Bill Clinton, now-King Charles, Princess Diana, John F. Kennedy Jr., Sen. Ted Kennedy and North Korean President Kim Jong Un.
Donald Trump Jr. was in Illinois on Friday to promote the bestselling book, Letters to Trump.
In Addison, the first event of the day where over 350 people packed into Venuti’s Banquet Hall to hear the former first son speak, Trump Jr. didn’t disappoint.

“I didn’t realize there were this many sane people in Illinois,” said Trump Jr. to a room full of laughter, before launching into his attacks against President Joe Biden; a struggling economy; a weaponized Department of Justice; a failed foreign policy strategy; and Hunter Biden’s addictions and corrupt business dealings.

Trump Jr. drew even more laughter when he said, “I understand that I’m the son of a billionaire from Manhattan. And if I’m at the grocery store with sticker shock – that’s a serious problem.”

During his 25-minute speech, Trump Jr. encouraged supporters of his father not to give up or give in to the pressure from the left.

“They want you to curl up in a ball and die, that is their win and they want you to think that it’s hopeless...They want you to think that there is nothing you can do.”

After the speech, Trump Jr. met with the media where he answered questions and addressed why he was visiting Illinois despite the Democrat’s control of the state.

“It’s not just trying to pick the states that you can win. It’s also picking the places where you can make a difference and perhaps move a needle in the congressional count and so all of that matters.”
Donald Trump Jr. met with the press following his speech in Addison on October 27, 2023. (Photo credit: Mark Vargas)
Following his appearance in Addison, Trump Jr. – accompanied by Trump family friend and Chicago ward committeewoman Eloise Gerson and Sergio Gor (https://45books.com/pages/about-us?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , president and founder of Winning Team Publishing, attended two private events in the western suburbs before heading down to southern Illinois to headline an event hosted by Republican congressional candidate Darren Bailey.

The visit to Illinois was not affiliated with the Donald J. Trump for President campaign and Donald Trump Jr. did not make any endorsements during Friday’s visit.

Illinois State Rifle Association Vice President Tony Clark presents Donald Trump Jr. with a lifetime membership during a private event in Illinois on October 27, 2023. (Photo credit: Mark Vargas)

On Friday, Illinois State Rifle Association Vice President Tony Clark presented Donald Trump Jr., son of the 45th President of the United States Donald J. Trump with a complimentary lifetime membership during an off-the-record private meet and greet in the western suburbs of Illinois.

Founded in 1903, the
ISRA (https://isra.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) is one of the oldest and most respected gun groups in the county and is celebrating its 120th anniversary this year.

Donald Trump Jr. was visiting

Trump Jr. is an unapologetic supporter of the 2nd Amendment and last year, he launched the 2nd Amendment Task Force (https://2ataskforce.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – whose mission is to stand up against the radical left policies of the Biden Administration and “mobilize freedom-loving Americans to fight back.”

In April of 2022 when Trump Jr. launched the group, he told
Fox News Digital (https://www.foxnews.com/politics/donald-trump-jr-launches-gun-rights-group-vows-fight?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ,

“The Second Amendment is the whole ballgame; it’s the freedom that protects all of our other freedoms. Unfortunately the Biden Administration and Democrats in Congress are hellbent on eroding our Constitutional right to keep and bear arms, whether it’s nominating radical gun-grabbers to senior positions in the executive branch or pushing anti-gun legislation.”

Trump Jr. concluded,

“The Second Amendment Task Force is entirely devoted to ensuring the Left is never successful in disarming American citizens.”

In
September (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/protestors-burn-american-flags-at-jason-aldean-concert-in-tinley-park-il-state-rifle-association-responds-offers-country-music-star-complimentary-lifetime-membership.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8b40ac336f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , the ISRA offered country music star Jason Aldean a complimentary lifetime membership after protestors burned American flags and chanted anti-American slogans in protest of Aldean’s number one hit song, ‘Try That In A Small Town.’ The scenes outside of Aldean’s concert in the suburbs of Chicago drew national attention and videos of the protestors burning flags and taunting the patriotic country music singer immediately began circulating on social media.

“Jason Aldean’s song, Try That In A Small Town, which hit number 1 on Billboard’s Hot 100 Chart has generated a lot of buzz, and even more controversy, but the lyrics represent what we’ve been fighting for as an organization for the last 120 years – and that’s the lawful right to protect yourself, your family and your community from danger. It’s not about promoting violence – it’s about preventing violence and allowing law-abiding citizens to defend themselves and others from those who wish to do harm.”

The organization then concluded their statement with,

“We applaud Jason on his success and standing up for our 2nd Amendment rights. As a token of our appreciation, we are honored to offer him a complimentary lifetime membership with the ISRA.”

On January 10, 2023, Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker (D) signed legislation banning so-called assault weapons, making Illinois just the 9th state to enact one of the strongest assault weapons bans in the country.

On January 18, 2023, the ISRA filed a federal lawsuit opposing Gov. Pritzker’s unconstitutional assault weapons ban.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Mike Rogers says assault weapons are “not the problem”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
#

Friend,
One of the core reasons I am running for Senate, and something that drives my work as a Congresswoman, is addressing the issues that are *truly* harming our children. Gun violence is the #1 killer of Americans under 21. That’s not a political statement, that’s a fact. In 2022, over 6,000 children 18 and younger were killed or injured due to gun violence in our communities, in our schools, by suicide, and by accident.
With the Michigan State shooting this year, and the Oxford High School shooting in 2021, I became the first Congresswoman to represent a district with two school shootings. And while I, like so many Michiganders, grew up with guns and then later carried weapons in three tours in Iraq alongside the military, the issue of gun violence has me by the throat. After the MSU shooting and manhunt, I received calls from Republican constituents that I know to be avid hunters and sportsmen, and they all have the same message: No one can stand to see their children dying in what should be their sanctuaries, and we need to do something to protect our babies.
That shift is why I find one of my Republican opponents’, Mike Rogers, comments on an assault weapons so telling: Two days after the mass shooting in Maine, where 18 people were killed by a mass shooter using an AR-10, Rogers went on Fox to reiterate his position that assault weapons are “not the problem” and a ban on these weapons wouldn’t help deal with the the issue of gun violence in America.
The most recent statement by Rogers simply reiterated his lifelong approach to gun safety: despite gun violence killing more children than car accidents since 2020, the government should take no further steps to try and mitigate risk. He has an A rating from the NRA and supported ending the assault weapons ban in 2004. But just in case you were wondering if his years away had changed him, or he might try and take a less tone-deaf position, or that watching the pain of families in Oxford or around MSU would have given him the courage to vote to protect kids, it has not. It appears he wasn’t aware that his comments would come just days before the independent review of the Oxford shooting would be published, making clear there are indeed legislative gaps to be filled to prevent a repeat of history.
Given the above, it’s clear that the issue of gun safety will clearly be a point of serious contrast in this Senate race. We don’t need another senator who refuses to take up even basic gun safety legislation, and who lives in fear of the NRA turning against him. And we don’t need another senator who can’t open their hearts and their eyes to the direct threat to our kids.
Thank you,
Elissa Slotkin

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 4145
East Lansing, MI 48826
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=764%2E135344%2EHOeeqL).

Friend,
I wanted to reach out to you myself because Republicans have already passed their first major piece of legislation under their new Speaker, Mike Johnson.
This bill is bad news for working families, the economy, and the climate.
A year ago, I fought to pass the Inflation Reduction Act, the most significant climate legislation that any country on the planet has ever passed. This bill boosts domestic manufacturing of clean energy, invests in the health of our forests and watersheds, and helps us tackle drought in the American West. All the while, it already has created thousands of good-paying jobs in Colorado, with thousands more on the way.
The Inflation Reduction Act reduces emissions, while building an economy that works for everyone. It’s a win-win. But under their new Speaker, Republicans in the House have passed a bill to repeal parts of this historic legislation.
I’ve spent years working on solutions to address the climate crisis, cut pollution, and ensure clean air and water for Coloradans. The Inflation Reduction Act is a critical piece of this.
At the end of this month, my campaign has a key fundraising deadline. name: NDRC Elections Update
subject: 3️⃣ reasons to care about Virginia’s elections
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
We’re just a few days away
|
---

We’ll keep this quick, team: There are just a few days remaining until Virginia’s legislative elections. Here are three reasons you should care:

**(1) The progress we’ve fought for is on the line.**

Our grassroots movement has worked hard to elect Democrats in Virginia – and these leaders have made incredible progress on issues like voting rights, gun safety, climate action, fair redistricting, and more. But if we fall short in November, _all_ of this progress will be on the chopping block.

**(2) If Republicans win, they’ll have the power to impose their _extreme_ MAGA agenda.**

Across the country, Republicans are passing extreme legislation to restrict reproductive freedom, attack the LGBTQ community, ban books, and more. If the GOP wins on Election Day, there will be nothing to stop them from enacting this extreme agenda.

**(3) The race is going to be tight – _really_ tight.**

Republicans need to flip **_just two seats_** in the Virginia Senate to win full control of Virginia’s state government. Multi-millionnaire governor Glenn Youngkin is investing heavily in competitive districts – and pro-democracy candidates across the state are counting on grassroots movements like ours to help them keep up.

For these reasons, NDRC has endorsed 99 Democracy Defenders running across Virginia, and we’re continuing to fight to strengthen our democracy nationwide. **There’s a lot at stake team – so here’s one way you can help: By donating to the NDRC!**

Peter: Here’s what I had to say when I voted for Rep. Hakeem Jeffries — and against Republicans’ newly elected Speaker of the House Mike Johnson:

**“Happy wedding anniversary to my wife.”**

Mike Johnson, a far-right ally of Donald Trump, voted against landmark marriage equality legislation that would protect marriages like mine and my wife, Cheryl’s.

He introduced a federal version of Florida’s “don’t say gay” bill and once said being queer is “sinful” and “destructive” as an attorney for the anti-LGBTQ+ group Alliance Defense Fund.

While we’ve come a long way toward achieving LGBTQ+ equality, Republicans’ decision to elect Mike Johnson proves they are hell-bent on taking us backward.

We are still seeing Republicans normalize anti-LGBTQ+ legislation more than two decades after I won a tough battle to adopt my son, Joshua, against a judge who said having two mothers was “not in the best interests of any child.”

That kind of rhetoric — and legislation that supports it — belongs in the past. But Republicans want to move anti-LGBTQ+ discrimination into 2023.

**Meanwhile, the vast majority of Americans support marriage equality.** It’s clear that the Republican Party is too extreme to represent the American people. Mike Johnson’s election as speaker is further confirmation of how radical they have become.

**[We can't allow Republicans to win in MN-02, expand their narrow majority and pass extreme anti-LGBTQ+ laws that set us back decades. Hi Peter,
Last week, I asked Congress to formally censure Marjorie Taylor Greene, and I stand by every word of my reasoning.
Racism, antisemitism, LGBTQ+ hate, Islamophobia, xenophobia, Asian hate, conspiracy theories, attacks on our democracy, and white nationalism have no place in our government. None. Ever.
Yet Marjorie Taylor Greene has spent her time in Congress focused on little else. She isn’t here to work for her constituents. She’s here to spread lies, conspiracies, and hate.
Peter, we can _never_ accept these wrongs, and I will always fight to make things right.
The stakes are incredibly high, so I’m asking you, one of my grassroots supporters – someone who knows the difference between wrong and right — will you chip in $27 ahead of tomorrow’s end-of-month deadline to keep me fighting for what’s right in Congress?

| | **For Immediate Release:** October 30, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min’s Statement On
Gun Show Bill Injunction**
**IRVINE, CA —** State Senator Dave Min has been a champion for gun violence prevention since he first sought public office. It was his [2021 bill](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bfe33daaee&e=7017cc100e) that ended gun shows at the Orange County fairgrounds and his subsequent [2022 bill](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=82bf2357c1&e=7017cc100e) which expanded the scope of the ban to all public property in the state. Today, a federal judge issued a preliminary injunction against those two bills. Dave Min’s full statement on today’s events is below:

**"Today's shocking injunction, a glaring example of judicial activism by a Trump-appointed judge, is a dire wake-up call to the very real dangers of GOP political control. It underscores the pressing imperative of electing a Democratic House majority to protect our values.

California's vital ban on gun shows at state properties, encompassing even our iconic fairgrounds sites, serves as a critical line of defense against the unchecked proliferation of firearms, including 'ghost guns' that circumvent essential background checks and traceability. This reckless decision– which essentially assumes its conclusion that any regulatory action related to guns is unconstitutional and further assumes– without any analysis or justification– that any such action creates the ‘irreparable harm’ required to issue a preliminary injunction– forces the state of California to host activities that we have determined we do not want on state-owned property.

While I am confident that this decision will be overturned on appeal, we cannot ignore the potentially catastrophic consequences it poses in the interim. Since being sworn into the State Senate in December 2020, I have sadly watched as gun violence has plagued the communities I represent, which are some of the safest in the country. The drive-by shooting of a 6-year old boy on the 55, the Orange office park shooting, the Taiwanese church shooting in Laguna Woods, the Cook’s Corner bar shooting, and so many others. I will continue fighting for gun violence prevention, but this decision underscores the barriers we are facing in that fight. Out-of-control judges who are essentially legislating from the bench must be reined in, and balance must be restored to our federal judiciary. Thoughts and prayers are no longer an adequate response to the mass shootings like the one we just saw in Maine. Action is required, and I pledge to push for action when I am elected to Congress next year.”**
_###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Peter,

Last week, President Biden made shameful remarks doubting the reports of
casualties coming out of the Gaza Health Ministry, suggesting they are
exaggerated.

In the days following that disgraceful statement, Israel went on to cut
off all of Gaza’s communications with the outside world — in direct
violation of international law — and carried out unprecedented bombings of
the Gaza strip in total darkness.

For days, Palestinians could not reach their families, nor could they call
for ambulances or medical aid to save innocent lives. Some were using
mosque megaphone systems to vocalize their prayers and desperate pleas for
help as bombs relentlessly fell throughout the night.

The videos and accounts coming out of Gaza in the aftermath show people
digging through collapsed buildings trying to find survivors, pulling
young children and babies from the rubble. People are starving and
desperately drinking seawater because they’ve run out of clean drinking
water and food. Hospitals are running out of fuel. This situation grows
more dire by the day.

Now, the death toll surpasses 8,000 people, including more than 3,300
children. Whether Biden believes it or not, those numbers are only growing
each day he enables Israel’s genocide and refuses to demand a ceasefire.

Israel has since restored Gaza’s internet after U.S. pressure, proving
that our government has the power and leverage to demand an end to this
violent ethnic cleansing we are not only witnessing but funding.

While bombs rained on Gaza over the weekend, millions of people in cities
around the world took to the streets for massive marches and displays of
solidarity with the Palestinian people, including thousands of people with
Jewish Voice for Peace and IfNotNow shutting down Grand Central Station in
New York City. Even the United Nations voted 120-14 for a ceasefire, but
the U.S. vetoed it.

Peter, the
majority of people in the U.S. and millions of others around the world are
calling for a ceasefire. But only 18 members of Congress, many of whom are
Justice Democrats-endorsed representatives, have signed on to the
resolution demanding it.

In this horrific moment in history, it’s up to us to continue using our
voices and power to stand up for the human rights of ALL people and urge
President Biden and Congress to do the right thing.

Go DBacks! #EmbracetheChaos | | |
---
| | Good afternoon Freedom Fighters,

I have been busy at the Capitol while balancing my time meeting face-to-face with voters in our legislative district since I was appointed at the end of July.

After I completed my second term serving in the House, I really missed brainstorming sessions with constituents to help solve issues in our neighborhoods, schools and in our state. Over the past several months I have hosted several dozen meetings and attended policy briefings with the goal of getting our state back on track.

While door-to-door campaigning constituents have echoed to me how their household has been directly impacted by Biden's high inflation economy. Fortunately, I have been able to educate voters on what the Republican legislative majority has been able to accomplish to help keep more money in your pocket, countering what is taking place at the national level.

That’s why I’m reaching out to you. As an action-oriented legislator, I rely on you to better educate me on what is taking place in your precinct and how legislative policies are affecting your household. I want to hear from you and your biggest concerns. If you would like to host a meet and greet in your precinct so we can hear from your neighbors, I would very much welcome the opportunity.

I am honored to be in a place to continue representing you, back at the Capitol doing the people's work. I look forward to continuing to work for you come January and thereafter.

I'm energized by your continued support and deeply grateful for the momentum we have built in such a short amount of time. Our team is robust and I'm confident we will prevail in the August primary.

For Arizona,

body:
Let me explain:
Peter —
I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I need your help.
We learned last week that my opponent Kevin Lincoln raised more money than any opponent I’ve faced while in office - and he was one of the top GOP fundraisers in the country thanks to pro-choice Republicans and special interests.
Now my team and I are trying to figure out what funds we have available to launch new ads ahead of our “top 2” primary, which is only a few months away.
**The problem is that because of my opponent’s strong fundraising, I don’t know if we can spend as much as we’d like on voter outreach. I’ve told my team we can only move forward if we raise $10,000 before the end of the month tomorrow.**
That’s why I’m coming to you, Peter. Will you make a rapid response donation before our deadline so we can reach voters without putting us in a fundraising hole against our opponent?
I’m dropping a custom ActBlue link here so I can personally thank everyone who helps us reach this goal.

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

[**Before I explain any more, I wanted to ask: Is there any way you can split a contribution between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign to help us reach our mid-month fundraising goal today? We’re in this race for the long haul. But it’s going to be tough.

With all the chaos in Washington (especially now), Montanans deserve someone who will crack down on the special interests and corruption in Washington, not play political games and cut backroom deals. We need to fight to lower costs for hardworking families, create good-paying union jobs, and ensure rural communities have what they need, like reliable internet and hospitals within driving distance.

Folks, I’m not a career politician. I’m pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. **I still farm the same land my grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago, and I try every day to do what’s right for the people of Montana and across the country.**

Because of that, I don’t have much patience for the fancy billionaires and shady super PACs a lot of other politicians rely on. Instead, I depend on grassroots supporters like you.

That’s why I’m so grateful you even opened this email. Emails like this one make up a big part of our budget. $5 here and $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours.

**So, here’s the part where I ask:** [**Can you make a split contribution of $17.77 (our average online donation) today to the Voter Protection project and my campaign meet our mid-month goal? Your donations keep me fighting for regular folks in Washington, and will help us respond to the onslaught of out-of-state money coming in to attack my record.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56239?t=13&akid=11598%2E878179%2EbjoAMw)
